subclassFeature.name: Rune Carver
entries: {@i 3rd-level Rune Knight feature}

You can use magic runes to enhance your gear. You learn two runes of your choice, from among the runes described below, and each time you gain a level in this class, you can replace one rune you know with a different one from this feature. When you reach certain levels in this class, you learn additional runes, as shown in the Runes Known table.

Whenever you finish a long rest, you can touch a number of objects equal to the number of runes you know, and you inscribe a different rune onto each of the objects. To be eligible, an object must be a weapon, a suit of armor, a shield, a piece of jewelry, or something else you can wear or hold in a hand. Your rune remains on an object until you finish a long rest, and an object can bear only one of your runes at a time.

If a rune has a level requirement, you must be at least that level in this class to learn the rune. If a rune requires a saving throw, your Rune Magic save DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

When you gain the Extra Attack feature, this special attack can be used for any of the attacks you make as part of the {@action Attack} action.

effects.description: You gain a Swim Speed equal to twice your Speed, and you can breathe underwater. Gills grow from your neck or flare behind your ears, and your fingers become webbed or you grow wriggling cilia.

effects.name: Glistening Flight
effects.description: You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, and you can hover. As you fly, your skin glistens with mucus or otherworldly light.

effects.name: See the Invisible
effects.description: You can see any Invisible creature within 60 feet of yourself that isn't behind Total Cover. Your eyes also turn black or become writhing sensory tendrils.

effects.name: Wormlike Movement
effects.description: Your body, along with any equipment you are wearing or carrying, becomes slimy and pliable. You can move through any space as narrow as 1 inch, and you can spend 5 feet of movement to escape from nonmagical restraints or the Grappled condition.

activation.condition: When a creature you can see within 60 feet is about to roll d20 with Advantage/Disadvantage

effects.name: Warded by Law
effects.description: When the warded creature takes damage, it can expend a number of those dice, roll them, and reduce the damage taken by the total rolled on those dice. The ward lasts until you finish a Long Rest or until you use this feature again.
For the duration, attack rolls against you can't benefit from Advantage, and whenever you make a D20 Test, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower on the d20 as a 10.

When you cast a spell that deals damage of your elemental affinity

effects.name: Winged
effects.description: he wings last for 1 hour or until you dismiss them (no action required). For the duration, you have a Fly Speed of 60 feet.

Immediately after you teleport
After teleporting

effects.name: Taunted
effects.description: This creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

Your thoughts can't be read by telepathy or other means unless you allow it. You also have Resistance to Psychic damage, and whenever a creature deals Psychic damage to you, that creature takes the same amount of damage that you take.

effects.name: Third Eye: Darkvision
effects.description: The Third Eye feature grants you Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

effects.name: Third Eye: Greater Comprehension
effects.description: The Third Eye feature grants you the ability to read any language.

subclassFeature.name: Warrior of Blades
entries: Warriors of Blades train relentlessly with their weapons, to the point where the weapon becomes an extension of the body. Founded on a mastery of sword fighting, the tradition has expanded to include many different weapons.

A warrior of blades sees a weapon in much the same way a calligrapher or painter regards a pen or brush. Whatever the weapon, the warrior views it as a tool used to express the beauty and precision of the martial arts. That such mastery makes one a peerless warrior is but a side effect of intense devotion, practice, and study.

subclassFeature.name: Kensei Weapons
entries: Choose two types of weapons to be your kensei weapons: one melee weapon and one ranged weapon. Each can be {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=xphb|type=simple weapon;martial weapon|category=basic|miscellaneous=}. You become proficient with these weapons if you weren't. Weapons of the chosen types are monk weapons for you. When you reach 6th, 11th, and 17th level in this class, you can choose another weapon meeting the criteria above. Your training with weapons allows you to use the {@variantrule weapon mastery properties|XPHB|mastery properties} of your kensei weapons. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can train with new weapons to change one of those choices.

subclassFeature.name: Agile Parry
entries: When you take the {@classFeature Deflect Attacks|Monk|XPHB|3|XPHB} reaction and are holding a {@subclassFeature Kensei Weapons|Monk|XPHB|Blades|Starlight|3|Starlight|Kensei weapon}, you may add your proficiency bonus to the damage reduction. You may draw a kensei weapon as part of the same reaction.

subclassFeature.name: Kensei's Shot
entries: You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make your ranged attacks with {@subclassFeature Kensei Weapons|Monk|XPHB|Blades|Starlight|3|Starlight|Kensei weapon} more deadly. Until the start of your next turn, when you hit with a ranged attack using a Kensei weapon, you deal additional damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

subclassFeature.name: Way of the Brush
entries: You gain proficiency with {@item Calligrapher's Supplies|XPHB} and {@item Painter's Supplies|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Empowered Kensei Weapons
entries: When you deal damage with a {@subclassFeature Kensei Weapons|Monk|XPHB|Blades|Starlight|3|Starlight|Kensei weapon}, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

subclassFeature.name: Deft Strike
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with a {@subclassFeature Kensei Weapons|Monk|XPHB|Blades|Starlight|3|Starlight|Kensei weapon} and deal damage, you can expend 1 Focus Point to deal additional damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with a Kensei weapon and deal damage

subclassFeature.name: Slice the Air
entries: You leap forward, a whirlwind of blade. While holding a kensei weapon, you can use an {@variantrule Action} to spend 3 Focus Points to draw a path of length equal to your {@classFeature Unarmored Movement|Monk|XPHB|2|XPHB} bonus, teleporting to the end. Each creature in the path or within 5 feet of it must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or take damage equal to three rolls of your Martial Arts die plus your Dexterity modifier, of a type matching the used kensei weapon. If your movement along that path would end in an obstacle or result in a condition that {@condition Restrained|XPHB|restrains} you, you stop at the last unoccupied space.

subclassFeature.name: Unerring Accuracy
entries: Once per turn, when you miss an attack roll with a Kensei weapon, you may reroll it, and you must use the new roll.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity: Guardian Angel
entries: As a reaction to a friendly creature within 30 feet of you taking damage, you can use your Channel Divinity to protect them, preventing the triggering damage and surrounding them in an invulnerable barrier which gives them resistance to all further damage.
If the protected creature makes an attack, casts a spell that affects an enemy, deals damage to another creature, or forces a creature to make a saving throw, the effect ends.

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity: Rallying Cry
entries: As a bonus action, you hold your weapon or arm aloft and shout a rallying cry, beckoning your allies forward.

You can use your Channel Divinity to choose creatures you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Until the end of their next turn, each of those creatures gains a bonus to weapon attack and damage rolls equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), and an additional 10 feet of movement speed.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the Oath of Unity Spells table.

entries.caption: Oath of Unity Spells
rows: {@spell Sanctuary}, {@spell Protection from Evil and Good}
{@spell Circle of Power}, {@spell Dispel Evil and Good}

subclassFeature.name: Tenets of Unity
entries: The Oath of unity is a vow taken to protect the ideals of community and the people within it. They seek to protect the people from evil, as the selfish can never truly be united. This often extends to powers and beings from other planes, who would seek to take aspects of the material plane for their own. The imagery of a paladin under this oath may take the shape of wings, as a protector or guardian angel, working together to protect people from the horrors that would tear them and their kingdoms apart.

You may have received your calling during a moment of heroism, or a moment of vulnerability, in the service or protection of others. Or perhaps you heard a voice on the wind, under a full moon. However this oath came to you, you value the safety of others above all, and seek to put down selfishness in all its forms.

entries.name: Community
entries: The people need you. Be their shield.

entries.name: Courage
entries: Bravery is not the absence of fear, but acting in spite of it. Evil prevails when good men do not act - so you should act.

entries.name: Honour
entries: Be fair and just. Your actions are your deeds. Avoid harm, but do not let that get in the way of doing good.

entries.name: Tolerance
entries: Intolerance cannot be tolerated. People may exist as they are, unless they threaten the peace of others. To stay neutral is to side with the oppressor.

entries.name: Integrity
entries: You cannot be responsible for others if you cannot hold yourself to account. Protect those in your care, and ensure that all authority is just.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Coordination
entries: Beginning at 7th level, your presence provides inspiration to your allies, allowing you to coordinate their movements. Friendly creatures that start their turn 10 feet of you may take the Disengage action as a bonus action on that turn.

subclassFeature.name: Resilient Spirit
entries: Beginning at 15th level, your presence is a stronghold. Each friendly creature within your Aura of Coordination regains hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) at the start of each of their turns, to a total no higher than your paladin level.

subclassFeature.name: Champion of the People
entries: At 20th level, your presence becomes a terror to enemies who stand against you, and you become a beacon of hope to your allies. As an action, you transform, becoming a shining beacon of unity for your allies to rally around. You may be surrounded by swirling sigils and sparkling moonlight.
During the transformation, you gain the following features for ten minutes:

items: Your aura is filled with bright moonlight.
Your spirit is empowered: friendly creatures within your aura have advantage on wisdom saving throws, and regain the maximum health possible from any healing.

Your resolve is unbreakable: when a friendly creature would be reduced to zero hit points or killed within your aura, they are instead reduced to one hit point. A given creature can benefit from this only once per long rest.
Your form cannot be changed against your will.

entries: Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

optionalfeature.name: Quick Reactions
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative}, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to roll your Hunter's Die and add it to the total. You can do so after the roll.
Additionally, you do not roll initiative with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} when you are {@status Surprised|XPHB}.

activation.condition: When you roll Initiative

optionalfeature.name: Herbalist
entries: You gain the {@feat Healer|XPHB} origin feat. You can use it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}.
Additionally, you gain proficiency with the {@item Herbalism Kit|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter's Insight
entries: You have a knack for reading people and their intentions. You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to add your Hunter's Die to any ability check you make using the {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}, or {@skill Deception|XPHB} skill. Additionally, you gain proficiency in one of those skills.
If you swap this Trick for another, you lose the proficiency.

activation.condition: When you make an ability check using Insight, Animal Handling, or Deception

optionalfeature.name: Physical Training
entries: You've trained for feats of physical prowess. You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to add your Hunter's Die to any ability check you make using the {@skill Athletics|XPHB} or {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB} skill. Additionally, you gain proficiency in one of those skills.
If you swap this Trick for another, you lose the proficiency.

activation.condition: When you make an ability check using Athletics or Acrobatics

optionalfeature.name: Scholarly Training
entries: You have a knack for pursuits of intellect. You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to add your Hunter's Die to any ability check you make using the {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@skill Religion|XPHB}, or {@skill History|XPHB} skill. Additionally, you gain proficiency in one of those skills.
If you swap this Trick for another, you lose the proficiency.

activation.condition: When you make an ability check using Athletics or Acrobatics

optionalfeature.name: Heavy Training
entries: You gain proficiency with Heavy Armour.

optionalfeature.name: Trip Attack
entries: You can attempt to trip a creature when you hit with an attack. You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} when you hit a creature to force it to make a Strength saving throw against your Hunter DC, falling {@condition Prone|XPHB} if it fails.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Retaliate
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} and a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an attack against that creature.

activation.condition: When a creature hits you with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Driving Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force the target to make a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Dazzling Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend two {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force the target to make a Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition Disoriented|Starlight}.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Feint
entries: You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} and a {@variantrule Bonus Action} to feint a creature within 5 feet of you. Your next attack against the target before the start of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage}.

description.chatFlavor: Gain advantage on your next attack.

optionalfeature.name: Finder of Traps
entries: You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} and a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to sense the location and purpose of any traps (and their triggers) within 60 feet of you.
A trap is any object or mechanism that was created or placed to cause damage or other danger. This could include spells, physical mechanisms, or even dangerous loopholes in a contract.

optionalfeature.name: Trapsetter
entries: At the start of each day, you can improvise {@item Ball Bearings|XPHB}, {@item Caltrops|XPHB}, {@item Acid|XPHB} or {@item Oil|XPHB}. You can {@action Utilize|XPHB} this improvised item with a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} instead of replacing an attack or using the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action.
Once created, the item lasts for 24 hours or until you improvise another, which costs 10gp and takes ten minutes.

optionalfeature.name: Parry
entries: When you are hit by an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} and your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage by one roll of your Hunter's Die plus your Proficiency Bonus.

activation.condition: When you are hit by an attack

optionalfeature.name: Preparations
entries: You can plan ahead when you know what the day holds.

At the start of each day, you can prepare a number of special coatings equal to your Proficiency Bonus. These coatings provide a +1 bonus to attack rolls and deal {@dice 1d4} additional damage of a damage type of your choosing other than force or psychic.
You can apply these to an arrow or other weapon with no action cost, but only one can be used at a time. The coatings retain their potency for 24 hours or until used, whereupon they last one minute.

optionalfeature.name: Naturally Talented
entries: You gain proficiency in a Hunter skill you are not already proficient in (Athletics, Acrobatics, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Stealth, Survival), then you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in one that you are proficient in.

optionalfeature.name: Trained in Darkness
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range is increased by 60 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Ricochet Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to cause the attack to ricochet or follow-through. Make an additional attack roll against a different creature within 5 feet of the original target. On a hit, the target takes damage equal to one roll of your Hunter's Die. This damage is of the weapon's type, and the attack retains any properties of the weapon or ammunition such as masteries or attack or damage bonuses.

optionalfeature.name: Readied Strike
entries: When a creature enters your reach and you are holding a melee weapon, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make an {@action Opportunity Attack} against them.

activation.condition: When a creature enters your reach and you are holding a melee weapon

optionalfeature.name: Environmental Conditioning
entries: Your exposure to a range of creatures and environments has taught you how to prepare for many a situation.

When you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can choose to become resistant to your choice of fire, cold, acid, lightning or thunder damage. This resistance lasts until you select another resistance through this feature.
resist: fire, cold, acid, lightning, or thunder

optionalfeature.name: Superior Stamina I
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or with no action required at the cost of one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}.
When you make any Constitution ability check, you can add your Hunter's Die to the roll, or to checks and saving throws made as part of a Chase.

optionalfeature.name: Inflicting Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force your target to make a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Bleeding|Starlight}.
The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of their turns to end the effect.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Searing Blow
entries: Your strike is so fast and vicious, or creates sparks when it hits strikes metal, that it ignites your target. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force your target to make a Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition Burning|Starlight}.
Once burning, the target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Pocket Sand
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to attempt to {@condition Blinded|XPHB|blind} a creature. Choose a creature within 5 feet of you. It must make a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the start of your next turn. You must have a free hand to use this Trick.

optionalfeature.name: Instinctive Mark
entries: You can mark a creature as your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} without using your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Shrug it Off Improvement
entries: When you use Shrug It Off, you can roll an additional Hunter's Die when determining the Temporary Hit Points gained.

As part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can choose to spend additional {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}, rolling one additional Hunter's Die for each Instinct spent.
Finally, you can use Shrug It Off to recover Hit Points, instead of gaining Temporary Hit Points.

optionalfeature.name: Sterner Stuff I
entries: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on any saving throws made against the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

optionalfeature.name: Indefatigable I
entries: You can remove one level of {@condition exhaustion} whenever you complete a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Nerve Strike
entries: You land attacks such that they affect your target's ability to react to events. When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force them to make an Intelligence saving throw or become {@condition Shocked|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Cunning Hunter I
entries: You can take the {@action Hide|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or with no action required at the cost of one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}.

When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|XPHB}) check, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to add your Hunter's Die to the total.

activation.condition: When you make a Dexterity (Stealth or Sleight of Hand) check.

optionalfeature.name: Sliding Attack
entries: You are especially manoeuvrable. You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} and an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to do a special {@action Dash|XPHB} which allows you to move through other creature's spaces and not provoke opportunity attacks. Once per turn, if you move through a creature's space as part of this, you can make one attack with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} against that creature.

optionalfeature.name: Deft Movement I
entries: You can take the {@action Disengage} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, or with no action required at the cost of one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}.

When you take the Disengage action, you can make one attempt to escape an effect causing you to be {@condition Grappled} or {@condition Restrained}. You can make this additional escape attempt no more than once per turn.

optionalfeature.name: Naturally Gifted
entries: You gain proficiency in any skill that you are not proficient in, then you gain {@variantrule Expertise|XPHB} in one that you are proficient in.

optionalfeature.name: Superior Stamina II
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Preceding Reputation
entries: You can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to add your Hunter's Die to an ability check that uses the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}, or {@skill Performance|XPHB} skills. Additionally, you gain proficiency in one of those skills.
If you replace this Trick with another, you lose the proficiency.

activation.condition: When you make an ability check using Intimidation, Persuasion, or Performance

optionalfeature.name: Honed Senses
entries: You can spend an {@variantrule Action} to regain Instinct equal to two rolls of your Hunter's Die.
You can do this once and must finish {@variantrule Long Rest} before you can do so again. You can also use it as part of rolling initiative without requiring an action.

optionalfeature.name: Eye on the Prize
entries: Opportunity attacks made against your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} do not require your {@variantrule Reaction}.

optionalfeature.name: Indefatigable II
entries: Once per turn when you regain hit points, including each time you roll a Hit Die during a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain an additional amount equal to your Wisdom modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Deft Movement II
entries: Your speed cannot be reduced unless a condition sets it to 0 directly.

You have {@variantrule Advantage} on saving throws and ability checks made to avoid the {@condition Grappled}, {@condition Restrained}, or {@condition Paralysed} conditions, and to escape manacles or similar restraints.

optionalfeature.name: Disarming Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to force it to make a Strength saving throw or let go of or drop an object of your choice that it is holding. The object lands in the creature's space if possible.

activation.condition: When you hit a creature with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Alpha Strike
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} when you roll initiative, you can replace the result of your {@dice d20} roll with a 20.
When you do this, you can add your Hunter's Die to the attack and damage roll of attacks you make in your first turn of combat.

optionalfeature.name: Sterner Stuff II
entries: You have resistance to necrotic damage and advantage on saving throws against the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} or {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} conditions.

optionalfeature.name: Cunning Hunter II
entries: You are untraceable. You make no sound when Hiding and cannot be tracked or seen by Divination or other magic unless you choose to be.

optionalfeature.name: Relentless Hunter
entries: Attacks you make against your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} bypass damage resistance, and treat damage immunity as resistance, and you cannot have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attacks against it.

optionalfeature.name: Watchful Hunter
entries: When an effect would reduce you to zero hit points, you can spend a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} and one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to be reduced to one instead. Then roll your Hunter's Die four times, add your Wisdom modifier, and regain hit points equal to the total rolled.

activation.condition: When you would be reduced to zero hit points

optionalfeature.name: Tactical Hunter
entries: If you have used your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to take another. You can use only one reaction per triggering event.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of the Planes
entries: You are trained to protect yourself from supernatural effects. You cannot be possessed.

Additionally, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to reroll a saving throw against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB}. You must use the new roll.

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: Outer Planes
entries: You feel most comfortable when things are strange. In environments on other planes, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks, you cannot become lost outside of magical means, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, you can forage for food in any environment, and while tracking other creatures you can learn their number and when they last passed through the area.

Additionally, you can spend one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to roll your Hunter's Die to identify supernatural danger. If you roll 4 or higher, you learn if you are being watched and how.
Finally, you can speak {@language Abyssal}, {@language Infernal}, {@language Celestial}, and {@language Deep Speech}.

activation.condition: When you feel you are being watched....

optionalfeature.name: Supernatural Defenses
entries: Your exposure to creatures from other planes has taught you how to resist their powers. You become resistant to necrotic, radiant, and psychic damage.

optionalfeature.name: Banishing Strike
entries: When you hit an Aberration, Celestial or Fiend with an attack, you can attempt to drive them away. Once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can spend two Instinct to cast the {@spell Banishment|XPHB} spell on the target. Success or fail, the target takes additional damage equal to two rolls of your Hunter's Die.

activation.condition: When you attempt to Banish a Celestial, Aberration, or Fiend

optionalfeature.name: Attunement with the Planes
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can cast the {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} spell, targeting only the Upper or Lower planes, or the Material Plane. You do not require the material components.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of Ghosts
entries: Borderland Hunters can pursue their foes even as they step into or through the Ethereal Plane. When you hit a creature with an attack, it cannot change the plane that it is on (for example, the {@spell Blink|XPHB} or {@spell Plane Shift|XPHB} spells) until the end of your next turn.
If you see a creature teleport, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to move up to your speed in pursuit of it.

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: Borderlands
entries: You are experienced travelling the lands that border your own. When travelling through the Ethereal Plane or the Feywilds, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks, you cannot become lost, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, you can forage for food in any environment, and you have advantage on ability checks or saving throws made to see through illusions.
Additionally, in the Ethereal Plane, any vertical movement does not impose a movement penalty.
Finally, you can speak {@language Sylvan}, {@language Goblin}, and {@language Elvish}.

optionalfeature.name: Visions of Death
entries: Once per turn while using Ethereal Shift, you can replace an attack you make with an attempt to {@condition Frightened|XPHB|Frighten} a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On failure, it becomes {@condition Frightened|XPHB} and takes two rolls of your Hunter's Die as psychic damage on a failure. On a successful saving throw, it takes half as much damage and is not {@condition Frightened|XPHB}.

activation.condition: When you replace an attack while using Ethereal Shift

optionalfeature.name: Ethereal Step
entries: Once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can cast the {@spell Etherealness|XPHB} spell on yourself as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. When cast this way, the spell lasts until the start of your next turn.
If you have already used this feature, you can use it again at the cost of four {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}.

optionalfeature.name: Halfway There
entries: When an attack would reduce you to zero hit points, you can make a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to 5 plus the damage taken. On a success, you are reduced to one hit point instead of zero. You can do this successfully once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.
You have advantage on Death saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of People
entries: You are trained to find people, no matter where they are hiding. You can add your Hunter's Die to ability checks using the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB}, {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB} or {@skill Deception|XPHB} skills that are made to gain information from others.

activation.condition: When you attempt to gain information using the Intimidation, Persuasion, Insight, or Deception skills

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: City
entries: You do your best work where people are. In cities and other settlements, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks, you cannot become lost outside of magical means, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, and you can find enough food to eat no matter where you are.
Additionally, you have advantage on ability checks made to identify local customs and find secret or hidden pathways in the environment.
Finally, you can speak {@language Thieves' Cant} and {@language Undercommon}.

optionalfeature.name: Building Scaler
entries: You are practised climbing buildings and leaping between them. You have a climbing speed equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} and your jump distance is doubled.

optionalfeature.name: No Way Out
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Opportunity Attack}, it is {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of the current turn. If it's your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}, it takes additional damage from that attack equal to your Hunter's Die.

activation.condition: When you hit your Quarry with an opportunity attack

optionalfeature.name: Pinning Strike
entries: Your attack is carefully aimed to impede your opponent's movement as much as possible. At the cost of one {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}, you can make an attack that, on a hit, forces the target to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is {@condition Restrained|XPHB} until the end of their next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of all Horizons
entries: When you cause a Beast or Monstrosity that is {@variantrule Bloodied|XPHB} to take damage, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it becomes {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you and will attempt to flee the encounter by the fastest available means. A creature can be forced to make this save only once per turn.

activation.condition: When you deal damage to a bloodied beast or monstrosity

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: Land, Sea and Sky
entries: You are adept at travelling the regions that most humanoids rarely do. When you travel through forests, plains, or regions with little solid ground such as the sky or large bodies of water, you have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks, you cannot become lost outside of magical means, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, and you can forage for food anywhere.
Additionally, you have advantage on ability checks made to control vehicles such as boats or airships.
Finally, you learn three standard languages of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Exploit Weakness
entries: When you would get a trophy from a creature, you can forgo that opportunity to instead create one of the following weaknesses to take your target down:

items: One of the creature's resistances or immunities is removed until the start of your next turn.
The creature becomes {@variantrule vulnerability|XPHB|vulnerable} to your next attack.
The creature becomes {@condition Dazed|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Adrenaline Rush
entries: While you are {@variantrule Bloodied|XPHB}, you add your Hunter's Die to all saving throws that you make.

activation.condition: When you are bloodied and make a saving throw

optionalfeature.name: Thrill of the Hunt
entries: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to one roll of your Hunter's Die plus your Wisdom modifier if you are {@variantrule Bloodied|XPHB} and have at least one {@variantrule Hit Point|XPHB}.

activation.value: When you are bloodied and start your turn

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of Fables
entries: You are trained to fight all manner of creatures, from the fantastical to the real. When you roll initiative, you can make a Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) or Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) ability check to determine either the Traits or Legendary Actions of a creature you can see, with a DC equal to 10 plus the creature's CR (maximum 30). You can add your Hunter's Die to this roll.

activation.condition: When you roll initiative

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: Myths
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|XPHB}) checks in environments that are home to Legendary creatures - such as volcanoes, the deepest caves, barren wastes or vast swamps. In such locations, you cannot become lost outside of magical means, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, you can forage for food in any conditions, and while tracking other creatures you can learn their number and when they last passed through the area.
Additionally, you have advantage on any saving throws made against environmental hazards such as heat or cold.
Finally, you learn one standard and one rare language of your choice.

optionalfeature.name: Previvify
entries: You can use an {@action Action|XPHB} on your turn to revive a friendly creature within your reach who is at zero hit points. They regain hit points equal to twice your Hunter level and gain the benefits of your {@subclassFeature Rally|Hunter|Starlight|Fable|Starlight|7|Starlight} and {@subclassFeature Commander|Hunter|Starlight|Fable|Starlight|3|Starlight} features (movement only). Once you have used this feature, you cannot do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

optionalfeature.name: Exploit Opening
entries: You guide your allies to success through your knowledge of these legendary creatures. Once per {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, when your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} succeeds a saving throw against one of your allies' effects, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause it to take force damage equal to four rolls of your Hunter's Die.

activation.condition: When your Quarry succeeds a saving throw against an ally

optionalfeature.name: Slayer of Legends
entries: When a Legendary creature is your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}, your Hunter's Die becomes {@dice 2d8} instead of {@dice 1d12}.

optionalfeature.name: Hunter of Primordials
entries: If you would take damage from a creature's Aura Trait, Death Burst, Breath weapon, or from hitting it with an attack, you reduce the final damage total by an amount equal to a roll of your Hunter's Die plus your Wisdom modifier.

activation.condition: When you you would take damage from a creature's Aura Trait, Death Burst, Breath weapon, or from hitting it with an attack

optionalfeature.name: Favoured Terrain: Elements
entries: You are experienced in extreme terrains where the elements rule: volcanoes, icy tundras, the deepest caves, places where there are many storms, or the elemental planes. When in these environments, you have Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} does not slow your travel, you can forage for food in any environment, and you have advantage on any saving throw against extreme or hazardous weather or environmental conditions such as heat or cold.

optionalfeature.name: Primal Conduit
entries: When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, you pull ancient threads together to create an effect depending on your {@subclassFeature Preferred Plane|Hunter|Starlight|Primordial|Starlight|3|Starlight}. The effect persists until the start of your next turn.

items: {@b Earth.} The path you walk becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. You are not affected by any {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} when Dashing.

{@b Water.} The path you walk becomes icy. You can walk on Water or similar surfaces, and another creature that stands on this trail must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

{@b Fire.} When you move within 5 feet of a creature, it takes {@dice 1d6} fire damage. You leave a trail of flames in your path which deals this damage again to any creature who enters it or ends their turn in it.
{@b Air.} You gain an additional 20 feet of movement when you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action.

activation.condition: When you take the Dash action
When you take the Dash action

optionalfeature.name: One with the Elements
entries: Once per {@variantrule Short Rest}, you can connect yourself to the Inner Planes very closely, borrowing their power (no action required).

items: {@b Earth.} You can move through solid ground until the end of your turn. If you are in the earth at the end of your turn, you are ejected to the nearest unoccupied space, taking {@dice 1d8} force damage for each 5 feet you are moved.
{@b Water.} You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your speed for the next hour. At the end of this period, you immediately begin suffocating if you cannot breathe.
{@b Fire.} When you deal Fire damage this turn, you can deal that Fire damage to another creature within 30 feet. This fire damage cannot spread in the same way.
{@b Air.} You can take an additional {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} before the start of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Djinni's Gift
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can spend two {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} to disappear in a flash of power, reappearing 60 feet away. Any creature within 10 feet of the space you left must make a Constitution saving throw, taking damage equal to two rolls of your Hunter's Die on a failure, of a type equal to your {@subclassFeature Preferred Plane|Hunter|Starlight|Primordial|Starlight|3|Starlight}.

optionalfeature.name: Path of the Conduit
entries: You are a conduit for nature's power directly. Shamans who take this path focus on the raw power of their spellcasting instead of any other means.

items: {@b Primal Clarity.} You can use a {@variantrule Reaction} to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a Shaman spell you cast if you would otherwise lose it. You can do this once, and regain the ability to do so after completing a {@variantrule Short Rest}.

activation.condition: When you would lose concentration on a Shaman spell

description.chatFlavor: The spirits maintain your grasp on a spell you would have otherwise lost.

optionalfeature.name: Path of the Runeblade
entries: The Runeblade is a direct means of controlling your primal magic into combat.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, you can conjure a Runeblade - an unusual Shaman-crafted weapon with a long hilt and blade, each emblazoned with runes representing your primal magic. A Runeblade is a martial melee weapon with the Versatile property. While wielded in two hands, it has the Reach property. It deals {@dice 1d8} ({@dice 1d10}) slashing damage plus the ability modifier used for the attack roll. Alternatively, you can have it take the form of a simple or martial weapon of your choice. It disappears if you conjure another or if it is out of your possession for one minute or more. It acts as a spellcasting focus for your Shaman spells.
{@b Battle Ready.} You gain proficiency with {@filter Martial weapons|items|type=martial weapon} and training with {@filter Medium armor|items|type=Medium Armor

description.chatFlavor: You convert a magic weapon that another creature is not attuned to and convert it into your Runeblade.

optionalfeature.name: Path of the Conjurer
entries: You manifest primal power differently, through tiny spirits in the form of totems. Shamans who take this path use their totems to aid their allies and hinder their foes in a variety of ways.

items: {@b Totems.} You gain the ability to summon a nature spirit totem. These tiny elemental creatures each apply a unique effect in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from themselves. If a totem deals damage, you are considered to have done that damage. Summoning a totem requires an Action, they appear in an unoccupied space within 60 feet, and you can have two such totems active at any time. Each totem lasts one minute. You can summon a totem at no cost, but must expend a 1st-level spell slot or complete a {@variantrule Short Rest} to do so again. You know how to summon two totems from the list below, and can change your selection whenever you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest}.
{@b {@creature Taunting Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Taunting}.} Creatures of your choice have disadvantage when attacking any creature in the area that isn't the totem.
{@b {@creature Warding Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Warding}.} {@condition Halted|Starlight|Halt} creatures of your choice who enter the emanation or end their turn in it.
{@b {@creature Warning Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Warning}.} You and allies in the area gain a +2 bonus to saving throws while in the emanation.

{@b {@creature Lifting Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Lifting}.} Creatures of your choice who enter the area can be lifted, leaping up to 30 feet in a direction they choose. Creatures who start their turn in the area gain 10 feet of movement speed until the start of their next turn.
{@b {@creature Blessing Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Blessing}.} Creatures of your choice can gain a +2 bonus to an attack roll or ability check once each round.
{@b {@creature Manatide Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight|Manatide}.} Creatures in the area gain +2 spell power.

description.chatFlavor: You conjure a nature spirit totem.

optionalfeature.name: Path of the Seer
entries: You can commune with spirits more directly, guiding them to assist you and your allies in many ways. Shamans who take this path might serve the role of oracles, advisors, or spiritual leaders.

items: {@b Guiding Spirits.} You can take the {@action Help} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action} and at a range of 30 feet.
{@b Spiritual Insights.} You gain proficiency in the {@skill Religion} or {@skill History} skill (your choice).

optionalfeature.name: Affinity with Flame
entries: You gain power from the brilliant heat of flames and day. You learn one Shaman cantrip that deals fire damage.

optionalfeature.name: Affinity with Frost
entries: You gain power from ancient frosts. You learn one Shaman cantrip that deals cold damage.

optionalfeature.name: Affinity with Lightning
entries: You gain power from static and storms. You learn one Shaman cantrip that deals lightning damage.

optionalfeature.name: Affinity with Thunder
entries: You gain power from clouds and skies. You learn one Shaman cantrip that deals thunder damage.

optionalfeature.name: Affinity with Acid
entries: You gain power from nature's lessons. You learn one Shaman cantrip that deals acid damage.

optionalfeature.name: Moonwatcher
entries: You do not need to sleep and cannot be forced to by any means. You can gain the benefits of a {@variantrule Long Rest} by doing 8 hours of light activity instead of sleeping.

optionalfeature.name: Nature's Understanding
entries: You can cast {@spell speak with animals} at will and without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Darkseer
entries: You gain darkvision out to 120 feet, or increase your existing darkvision by 120 feet. Your darkvision makes darkness appear as bright light to you, instead of dim.

optionalfeature.name: Sense Arcana
entries: You can cast {@spell Detect Magic|XPHB}, {@spell Detect Evil and Good}, and {@spell Detect Poison and Disease} once per {@variantrule Long Rest} each, without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Lightfeet
entries: You learn the {@spell Longstrider|XPHB} and can cast it once per {@variantrule Long Rest} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Jungle's Bounty
entries: You can cast the {@spell Goodberry|XPHB} spell once per {@variantrule Long Rest} without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell in this way, you create an additional number of berries equal to your proficiency bonus.

optionalfeature.name: Natural Instincts
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Survival} and {@skill Medicine} skills.

optionalfeature.name: Rites of Passage
entries: Gain an {@filter Origin feat|feats|category=o} of your choice that you do not already have. You can learn this Rune more than once.

optionalfeature.name: Ancient Wards
entries: When a creature within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction} to deal Psychic damage to the attacker equal to your Proficiency Bonus and shove them 10 feet away from their target.

activation.condition: When a creature within 30 feet of you is hit by an attack

description.chatFlavor: Rebuke the attacker: damage and move them.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Manipulation
entries: You can change the damage type of a spell you cast to the damage type of your Elemental Affinity.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Conduit
entries: You may add your spellcasting ability modifier to the damage you deal with any cantrip that deals fire, cold, thunder, lightning, or acid damage.

optionalfeature.name: Roots of the Tree
entries: You may a add bonus equal to your proficiency bonus to saving throws made to maintain your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit's Intuition
entries: You learn the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. It has a duration of ten minutes when you cast it.

optionalfeature.name: Far Sight
entries: As part of a ten-minute ritual, you look into the future, sensing a power you might require. You may ask a question about an event to occur within the next 7 days, and the DM may suggest a spell or type of spell that would prove beneficial. You can then swap one spell that you know for another you can learn on the Shaman spell list, following normal spellcasting rules. You may do this only once per day.

optionalfeature.name: Natural Warrior
entries: You learn the {@spell Shillelagh} cantrip, and when you cast it it lasts for ten minutes and can be applied to any weapon with which you are proficient.

optionalfeature.name: Runeblade Training
entries: When you conjure a Runeblade, it has the {@itemMastery Push|XPHB} mastery, or the mastery property of the weapon it takes the form of, and you can use that mastery with your Runeblade. Additionally, you can cause your Runeblade to deal damage of your Elemental Affinity's type instead of its normal type.

optionalfeature.name: Runic Strikes
entries: When you hit a creature with your Runeblade, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to deal 2d6 damage of the type associated with your Elemental Affinity, and cause an additional effect associated with your Elemental Affinity, which lasts until the start of your next turn. The damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

items: {@b Fire.} Creatures within 5 feet of you take fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
{@b Cold.} The target's next saving throw is reduced by 2.
{@b Lightning.} You can immediately move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
{@b Thunder.} The target becomes {@condition Prone}.
{@b Acid.} Viscous acid causes the target to become {@condition Grappled|Starlight} by you (no hand required).

optionalfeature.name: Forest Heart
entries: You learn the {@spell Summon Fey|TCE} spell.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Thorns
entries: Upon taking damage from a creature within 5 feet of you, you can spend a {@variantrule Reaction} to deal {@dice 1d6} damage of the type associated with your elemental affinity to that creature.
This damage increases to {@dice 2d6} at 11th level and {@dice 3d6} at 17th level.

optionalfeature.name: Runeblade Adept
entries: When you take the Attack action, you can make one additional attack on your turn, provided you attack only with your Runeblade.

optionalfeature.name: Gifts of the Elders
entries: You learn the {@spell Borrowed Knowledge|SCC} and {@spell Enhance Ability|XPHB} spells. When you cast it, Borrowed Knowledge can affect another creature in Touch range.

optionalfeature.name: Nature Companion
entries: You can cast the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell once per {@variantrule Long Rest} without requiring material components. Your familiar takes the form of a {@creature Sapling Treant|Starlight} or a {@creature Raven|MM}.

optionalfeature.name: Totemic Blast
entries: Your totems gain the ability to launch a blast of elemental magic. The blast uses your spell attack modifier, is fired from an active totem using your {@variantrule Bonus Action}, and deals {@damage 1d8+PB} damage of a type matching your elemental affinity.
{@note This ability is listed in the Nature Spirit Totems' statistics.}

optionalfeature.name: Rune of Elemental Superiority
entries: When you deal damage of the type associated with your elemental affinity, you ignore resistance to damage of that type.

optionalfeature.name: Druidic Teachings
entries: You learn the {@spell Polymorph} spell.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Aversion
entries: You learn the {@spell Elemental Bane|XGE} spell. Once per {@variantrule Long Rest}, when you cast this spell, you can forgo the need to {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on it by reducing its duration to the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Totemic Might
entries: When you summon a totem, it gains temporary hit points equal to twice your proficiency bonus.
Additionally, your totems become proficient in all saving throws.

optionalfeature.name: Totemkeeper
entries: When expending a spell slot to summon a totem, you may summon two at once if the spell slot expended is of third level or higher.

optionalfeature.name: Keen Spirits
entries: When you {@action Help|XPHB} to assist an attack with Guiding Spirits, you can increase the power of the attack. If the assisted attack hits, you can cause it to deal an additional {@dice 2d6} psychic damage.

optionalfeature.name: Exchange Arcana
entries: You can prepare 3 additional Shaman spells beyond the value listed in the table, following the usual rules for doing so.

When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can perform a primal rite to exchange knowledge. When you perform this rite, you can replace a number of your prepared spells with an equal number of Shaman spells for which you have spell slots. The number is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.

optionalfeature.name: Small Friends
entries: You learn the {@spell Insect Plague|XPHB} spell. You can communicate with insects freely.

optionalfeature.name: Keeper of the Grove
entries: As an {@variantrule Action}, you can channel nature to siphon a creature's magic for a turn.
The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@dice 3d12} radiant damage and becomes {@condition silenced|Starlight} until the end of your next turn.
You can do this a number of times per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

description.chatFlavor: Nature attempts to siphon the creature's magic.

optionalfeature.name: Totem Commander
entries: You have greater control over where your totems are summoned. You can summon them in the air, or attached to you or a willing creature.

A totem attached to a creature moves with it, but can still be targeted individually. If attached to a creature, you can expend a {@variantrule Reaction} to force the totem to be the new target of an attack that would otherwise hit the creature it is attached to.
{@note This ability is listed in the Nature Spirit Totems' statistics.}

optionalfeature.name: Forest Walker
entries: You learn the {@spell Transport Via Plants|XPHB} spell and can cast it once per {@variantrule Long Rest} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Primal Confluence
entries: When you cast a Primordial spell of 5th level or lower, you can choose two of the spell's optional effects instead of one. You can do this once per {@variantrule Long Rest}.

optionalfeature.name: Runeblade Master
entries: You can make 2 additional attacks instead of one when you take the {@variantrule Attack} action and attack with your Runeblade.

optionalfeature.name: Spirit Shield
entries: You learn to shield your allies from harm in an instant. When another creature within 30 feet of you makes a Saving Throw, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction} to grant a bonus to the roll equal to your Shaman level. You can do this once per {@variantrule Short Rest}.

optionalfeature.name: Bolstered Summons
entries: When you summon a creature, it gains a +2 bonus to its Armour Class.

optionalfeature.name: Master of Roots
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest}, you can cast the {@spell Grasping vine|XPHB} spell. When you do so, you can either cast the spell as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, or forgo the need to {@statusConcentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Command of Air
entries: You can cast the {@spell Fly|XPHB} spell at will.

optionalfeature.name: Command of Earth
entries: You gain Tremorsense to a range of 30 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Command of Water
entries: You can cast {@spell Water Walk|XPHB} and {@spell Water Breathing|XPHB} (self only) at will, and learn both spells.

optionalfeature.name: Nature's Will
entries: If you cast a spell and miss all of its attack roll(s), or all targets pass their saving throws to resist its effect, you can cast a cantrip as a {@variantrule Bonus Action} instead of an {@variantrule Action}. You may do this once per {@variantrule Short Rest}.

optionalfeature.name: Manarage Totem
entries: You can summon a {@creature Manarage Nature Spirit Totem|Starlight} once per {@variantrule Short Rest}. Within its emanation, creatures can cast a first level spell or use a Short-Rest-recovery ability once without expending a spell slot, or use of that feature.

optionalfeature.name: Empower Runeblade
entries: You can expend a spell slot of 5th level or higher (no action required) to empower your Runeblade for the next minute. For that duration, your Runeblade deals an additional 1d10 force damage and you regain hit points equal to the force damage dealt.

optionalfeature.name: Tree of Life
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest}, you can use an {@variantrule Action} to imbue the world around you with the healing power of nature: {@b all} creatures within 100 feet of you regain 120 hit points.

description.chatFlavor: Life is given to all creatures nearby

optionalfeature.name: Shared Prophecy
entries: You learn the {@spell Foresight} spell. When you cast it, you can cast it on yourself and another creature at the same time. Casting the spell this way reduces its duration to one hour.

optionalfeature.name: Transmute Body
entries: You learn the {@spell Shapechange} spell. You retain the ability to summon totems in this form and can do so as a {@variantrule Bonus Action} while transformed.

optionalfeature.name: Searing Heat
entries: Once on each of your turns when you deal fire damage to a creature, you can cause them to become {@condition Burning|Starlight} for one minute, or until they end the condition another way.

optionalfeature.name: Roaring Flames
entries: The size of your spells that deal fire damage, if they specify an area, increase by 5 feet when you cast them (for example, {@spell Burning Hands|XPHB} increases from a 15-foot cone to a 20-foot cone). If a spell specifies multiple dimensions, such as {@spell Wall of Fire|XPHB}, you choose one to increase.

optionalfeature.name: Compound Burns
entries: When you deal fire damage to a {@condition Burning|Starlight} creature, it takes additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

optionalfeature.name: Biting Cold
entries: Once per turn when you deal cold damage to a creature, you can cause them to become Brittle until the start of your next turn. A creature can use a Bonus Action to shake the frost from themselves, ending the effect.

optionalfeature.name: Ice Block
entries: When you deal cold damage with a spell of 1st level or higher on the turn that you cast it, you can gain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus times the number of creatures you dealt damage to with that spell.

optionalfeature.name: Absolute Zero
entries: When you deal cold damage to a creature, the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn is reduced by {@dice 1d4}.

optionalfeature.name: Arc Lightning
entries: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature with a lightning spell, you can deal half that damage to another creature within 15 feet who was not a target of the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Aftershock
entries: Once per turn when you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can give it the {@condition Shocked|Starlight} condition until the end of your next turn.

optionalfeature.name: Supercharge
entries: When you take lightning damage, your next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw has {@variantrule Advantage}.
At 18th level, you gain this benefit even if your {@classFeature Elemental Embodiment|Shaman|Starlight|18|Starlight|immunity} would prevent the damage.

optionalfeature.name: Thundercrack
entries: When you deal thunder damage to a creature that is large or smaller, you can move it 5 feet away from the source of the damage. You deal maximum damage instead of rolling when you deal thunder damage to an object.

optionalfeature.name: Echoing Thunder
entries: Once per turn, when a creature fails a saving throw against a spell that deals Thunder damage, you can cause it to become {@condition Rattled|Starlight}.

optionalfeature.name: Booming Thunder
entries: Your {@b Thundercrack} rune improves. You are able to push creatures of any size, and the distance increases to 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Corroding Acid
entries: When you deal acid damage to a creature, you can coat them in acid, giving them the {@condition Melting|Starlight} condition for the next minute or until they or a creature within 5 feet of them uses an {@variantrule Action} to end it. You can only have one creature Melting in this way at a time.

optionalfeature.name: Sulphur Pools
entries: Once per turn when you deal acid damage to a creature, you can create a 5-foot square of acid on the surface that creature is standing on. If a creature ends their turn in the acid, they take acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The acid is difficult terrain.

optionalfeature.name: Viscous Acid
entries: Your {@b Corroding Acid} is more powerful. A creature suffering from the effect is {@condition Hampered|Starlight} and deals {@damage 1d4} less damage with weapon attacks.

optionalfeature.name: Valley Echoes
entries: When you use your {@subclassFeature Earthen Scales|Shaman|Starlight|Mountains|Starlight|3|Starlight|Earthen Scales}, the creature you target can use a {@variantrule Reaction} to make a weapon attack.

optionalfeature.name: Avatar of the Mountains
entries: When using your {@classFeature Spiritual Avatar|Shaman|Starlight|20|Starlight|spiritual avatar} feature, you are resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

optionalfeature.name: Elemental Geyser
entries: When you use your {@subclassFeature Ebb|Shaman|Starlight|Waters|Starlight|3|Starlight|Ebb} and {@subclassFeature Flow|Shaman|Starlight|Waters|Starlight|3|Starlight|Flow} water jets, you can choose to make its damage match your elemental affinity instead of bludgeoning.

optionalfeature.name: High-pressure Jet
entries: Your {@subclassFeature Ebb|Shaman|Starlight|Waters|Starlight|3|Starlight|Ebb} and {@subclassFeature Flow|Shaman|Starlight|Waters|Starlight|3|Starlight|Flow} water jets also push creatures back 5 feet when you hit them with it. At level 14, this increases to 10 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Avatar of the Waters
entries: When using your {@classFeature Spiritual Avatar|Shaman|Starlight|20|Starlight|spiritual avatar} feature, you regain 15 hit points at the start of each of your turns.

optionalfeature.name: Heatwave
entries: When using your {@subclassFeature Mirage|Shaman|Starlight|Dunes|Starlight|3|Starlight}, you can deal damage of the type associated with your elemental affinity equal to your proficiency bonus to all other creatures of your choice within 5 feet of the space you left.

optionalfeature.name: Avatar of the Dunes
entries: When using your {@classFeature Spiritual Avatar|Shaman|Starlight|20|Starlight|spiritual avatar} feature, you gain an additional {@variantrule Reaction} each round.

optionalfeature.name: Leeching Seeds
entries: When you damage a creature affected by your {@subclassFeature Wild Mark|Shaman|Starlight|Waters|Starlight|3|Starlight}, you regain {@dice 1d4} hit points.

optionalfeature.name: Avatar of the Forests
entries: When using your {@classFeature Spiritual Avatar|Shaman|Starlight|20|Starlight|spiritual avatar} feature, you are naturally camouflaged. When taking damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction} to become {@condition Invisible} until the end of your next turn.

item.name: +1 Strider's Signet
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to your Hunter save DC while wearing this signet. Additionally, when you attune to this item you can touch up to 2 weapons (including your unarmed strikes) with which you are proficient. While wearing the signet, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls to each of those weapons, provided the weapon doesn't already grant a bonus to those rolls.

When you roll {@variantrule Initiative}, you can mark a creature as your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} without requiring {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} or a {@variantrule Bonus Action}. Once you mark a creature in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest}.

item.name: +2 Strider's Signet
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to your Hunter save DC while wearing this signet. Additionally, when you attune to this item you can touch up to 2 weapons (including your unarmed strikes) with which you are proficient. While wearing the signet, you gain a +2 bonus to the attack and damage rolls to each of those weapons, provided the weapon doesn't already grant a bonus to those rolls.

When you roll {@variantrule Initiative}, you can mark a creature as your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} without requiring {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} or a {@variantrule Bonus Action}. Once you mark a creature in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest}.

item.name: +3 Strider's Signet
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to your Hunter save DC while wearing this signet. Additionally, when you attune to this item you can touch up to 2 weapons (including your unarmed strikes) with which you are proficient. While wearing the signet, you gain a +3 bonus to the attack and damage rolls to each of those weapons, provided the weapon doesn't already grant a bonus to those rolls.

When you roll {@variantrule Initiative}, you can mark a creature as your {@classFeature Quarry|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} without requiring {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight} or a {@variantrule Bonus Action}. Once you mark a creature in this way, you cannot do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest}.

item.name: Staff of the Crossroads Watcher
items: +1 Staff of the Crossroads Watcher|Starlight
+2 Staff of the Crossroads Watcher|Starlight
+3 Staff of the Crossroads Watcher|Starlight

item.name: +1 Staff of the Crossroads
entries: While holding this staff, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your {@filter Shaman spells|spells|class=Shaman}. This weapon also has a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
When you use a feature granted by your Path of the Shaman, you gain an additional benefit based on that path. You can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

items: {@b Conduit.} When you cast a Shaman spell, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of that spell.
{@b Conjurer.} When you summon a totem, you can increase the radius of the totem's {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} to 20 feet.
{@b Runeblade.} When you conjure your Runeblade, you can make one attack as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action}.
{@b Seer.} When a creature you {@action Help|XPHB} succeeds on the roll, you or they (your choice) gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

item.name: +2 Staff of the Crossroads
entries: While holding this staff, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your {@filter Shaman spells|spells|class=Shaman}. This weapon also has a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
When you use a feature granted by your Path of the Shaman, you gain an additional benefit based on that path. You can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

items: {@b Conduit.} When you cast a Shaman spell, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of that spell.
{@b Conjurer.} When you summon a totem, you can increase the radius of the totem's {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} to 20 feet.
{@b Runeblade.} When you conjure your Runeblade, you can make one attack as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action}.
{@b Seer.} When a creature you {@action Help|XPHB} succeeds the assisted action, you or they (your choice) gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

item.name: +3 Staff of the Crossroads
entries: While holding this staff, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your {@filter Shaman spells|spells|class=Shaman}. This weapon also has a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
When you use a feature granted by your Path of the Shaman, you gain an additional benefit based on that path. You can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

items: {@b Conduit.} When you cast a Shaman spell, you can add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of that spell.
{@b Conjurer.} When you summon a totem, you can increase the radius of the totem's {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} to 20 feet.
{@b Runeblade.} When you conjure your Runeblade, you can make one attack as part of that {@variantrule Bonus Action}.
{@b Seer.} When a creature you {@action Help|XPHB} succeeds the assisted action, you or they (your choice) gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

item.name: Necklace of Bitter Tears
entries: Whenever you regain hit points while wearing this necklace, your weapon attacks before the end of your next turn deal an additional {@dice 1d6} poison damage.

item.name: Bracers of Extreme Evocation
entries: Whenever you cast a spell, you can select the relevant option from the following list in order to roll an additional {@dice 2d6} damage when determining the spell's damage. If a spell requires multiple attack rolls, this applies to all of them.

items: If the spell requires an attack roll, take a -5 penalty to that roll.
If it requires a saving throw, targets have advantage on that saving throw.

item.name: Gloves of Benign Transposition
entries: When you hit or affect a willing creature with an attack or spell using Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma, you may swap places with them.

item.name: Gloves of Malicious Transposition
entries: These gloves have 3 charges, which are restored when you complete a long rest. When you hit or affect a creature with an attack or spell, you may expend a charge to swap places with them. An unwilling creature may make a DC 15 Charisma saving throw to avoid the effect.

item.name: Ring of Mana Channeling
entries: While concentrating, your weapon attacks deal 2 additional damage of the weapon's type.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The additional damage is force, and equal to your spellcasting ability modifier instead of 2.

item.name: Ring of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while wearing this ring.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: and +1 to AC.

item.name: Cloak of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while wearing this cloak.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: and +1 to AC.

item.name: A Promise Made
entries: This ring shares a single charge with {@item A Promise Kept|Starlight}, which recovers when you complete a long rest.
The wearer can expend the charge to cast {@spell Unshakeable Tail|J:Portalist}, {@spell Warding Bond|phb}, or {@spell Sanctuary|phb} on the bearer of A Promise Kept.

item.name: A Promise Kept
entries: This ring shares a single charge with {@item A Promise Made|Starlight}, which recovers each when you complete a long rest.
The wearer can expend the charge to cast {@spell Unshakeable Tail|J:Portalist}, {@spell Warding Bond|phb}, or {@spell Sanctuary|phb} on the bearer of A Promise Made.

item.name: Circlet of Storytelling
entries: Stories you tell gain a subtle effect to make them more compelling.
You have advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks, and can conjure small images of the tales you tell in the form of blurred cloudy images above your head.

item.name: Soulful Rook Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the floor of the rook's battlements glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any cardinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, forces the target to make a DC 13 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are moved 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Queen Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the queen's crown glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any ordinal or cardinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, forces the target to make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are {@condition Frightened|phb} of you until the start of your next turn.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Bishop Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the bishop's mitre glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 90 feet in any ordinal direction. You may not teleport past any creature in those directions.

Additionally, you roll an additional {@dice 1d6} when determinig the damage of the next attack you make this turn after teleporting. This attack can restore hit points, instead of dealing damage, if you choose.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Soulful Knight Chesspiece
entries: This appears to be a normal chesspiece, except that the floor of the rook's battlements glows slightly.
You may teleport up to 60 feet in any direction except the cardinal or ordinal ones.
Additionally, the next attack you make this turn after teleporting, on a hit, {@condition Hampered|Starlight|Hampers} your target's movement until the start of your next turn.
You may use this ability only if you haven't moved this turn, and you are {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of your turn when you use it.
Once the piece has been used this way, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest, during which time the piece stops glowing.

item.name: Quickstep Boots
entries: When you take the dodge action while wearing these boots, you can immediately move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

item.name: Eye of the 10-eyed Wyrm
entries: One of the eyes of the mighty Dreaad Serpent Anach-Tal'lul. merely possessing it grants the bearer one of His many powers. Such powers can be difficult to handle, however, and this imposes limitations on mortals using them.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The eye has two charges, which recover when you complete a long rest. As an action, you can expend one charge to grant yourself one benefit from the table, and its associated detriment, for one hour.

rows: You gain advantage on initiative checks.
On your first turn in combat, you are {@condition Slowed|Starlight}.
You gain advantage on Wisdom ability checks.
You gain disadvantage on Intelligence ability checks.
You gain advantage on all attacks.
You gain disadvantage on all saving throws.
You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
You gain vulnerablity to fire, cold, and lightning damage.

item.name: Blessed Circlet
entries: You receive {@dice 1d4} (additional) hitpoints when you are healed with a spell, or when you heal others with a spell.

item.name: Career Student's Ring
entries: While wearing this ring, you can add half of your proficiency bonus to any any skill in which you are not already proficient.
{@note This does not combine with the Bard's 'Jack of All Trades' feature, or other similar features.}

item.name: Forgotten Green Hood
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth or Sleight of Hand) checks.
You cannot be targeted by Divination magic or perceived through magical means, such as a Scrying sensor or looking through a familiar's eyes.

item.name: Friend of Arcanists
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana) and Intelligence (History) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Druids
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence (Nature) and Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Priests
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Intelligence (Religion) and Wisdom (Medicine) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Warriors
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Strength (Athletics) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Parties
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Performance) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Thieves
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Urchins
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Wisdom (Survival) and Wisdom (Perception) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of the Paranoid
entries: You have a +1 bonus to Charisma (Deception) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Friend of Light-foots
