entries: You have a +1 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The bonus is a +2 instead.

item.name: Hunter's Shawl
entries: While wearing this cloak, if you kill a creature, you gain temporary hit points equal to its CR or level.

item.name: Hunter's Hood
entries: You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to spot creatures who are hiding from you.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can cast the {@spell Hunter's Mark|phb} spell at 3rd level. A creature marked in this way takes the additional damage from {@b all} weapon attacks, not just yours. Once you do so, the spell cannot be cast this way until you complete a long rest.

item.name: Hunter's Boots
entries: You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape being {@condition Grappled|phb|grappled} or {@condition Restrained|phb|restrained.}

item.name: Hunter's Bracers
entries: Hostile creatures within 5 feet of you do not impose disadvantage on your ranged attacks.

item.name: Hunter's Ring
entries: You gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to attack rolls made against creatures who are under the effects of {@spell Guiding Bolt|phb}, {@spell Hunter's Mark|phb}, {@spell Faerie Fire|phb}, or the {@classFeature Favoured Foe|Ranger|phb|1|tce} feature.

item.name: Moon-Touched Bracelet
entries: You have resistance to radiant damage while you are wearing this ring.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can store one spell of up to 3rd level within the bracelet. Any creature can cast a spell of 1st through 3rd level into the bracelet by touching the bracelet as the spell is cast. The spell's effect is then stored for later use.

While wearing the bracelet, you can cast the spell stored in it; the spell uses the same level as when it was cast, as well as the spell save DC, attack bonus and spellcasting ablity of the original caster, but is otherwise treated as if you had cast it. Once cast, the spell is removed from the bracelet, freeing up the space.

item.name: Ring of Borrowed Time
entries: If you have the {@condition Dying|Starlight} condition at the start of your turn, you instead enter a new state where you borrow time from your own potential future.
Instead of rolling a death saving throw at the start of your turns, you fail your death saving throw automatically at the end of your turns, but can otherwise act without penality.
This ends when the dying condition would. After the ring has put you into this alternate state, once you leave that state, the ring loses its magic until you complete a long rest.

item.name: Cloak of the Timekeeper
entries: Attacks that deal force damage have disadvantage against you, and you have advantage on any saving throw against an effect that would cause you to take force damage on a success or failure.

item.name: Stopped-clock Circlet
entries: As a reaction, you can halt an effect or spell that targets an area that you can see. Before the end of your next turn, you can release the effect (no action required) at its original target space.
Once used, this cannot be used again until you complete a long rest.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can choose to {@status Concentration|XPHB|Concentrate} on the effect (as if you were {@status concentration|XPHB|concentrating} on a spell) in order to choose a new target point from the effect when you release it (as if it originated from you). It still uses the original statistics.

item.name: Time-knife Gloves
entries: Whenever you hit a creature with an attack roll while wearing these gloves, it loses a reaction, if it has at least one.

item.name: Boots of Excellent Positioning
entries: These boots have 5 charges which are recovered upon completing a long rest. Whenever you are moved against your will, you can expend a reaction and one charge to teleport to any space you occupied after the start of your previous turn.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You can use the reaction and expend a charge at any time, instead of only when you are moved against your will.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: While in combat, you regain {@dice 1d4} hit points at the start of each of your turns.

item.name: Amulet of Unmitigated Gall
entries: Anyone wearing this amulet cannot have disadvantage on Charisma ability checks.
The wearer has a +1 bonus to Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Deception) checks.

item.name: Cloak of the Profane Elf
entries: {@b Hellish Rebuke.} Creatures that hit you with a melee attack become {@condition Burning|Starlight} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Cloak of Arcane Bolstering
entries: Gain temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier when you cast a spell while within 5 feet of a hostile creature.

item.name: Cloak of the Wind
entries: Your movement speed is increased by 5 feet.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: Your movement speed is increased by 10 feet instead.

item.name: Apathetic Cloak
entries: This cloak foils spells cast to determine your thoughts and intentions (such as {@spell Detect Thoughts|PHB} or {@spell Zone of Truth|PHB}), and grants you advantage on Intelligence saving throws.

item.name: Sanctuary Rose Cutting
entries: This pale blue rose petal glows dimly within its jar, emitting 5 feet of dim light at all times and is surrounded by floating motes of light, which occasionally hit the glass.

While holding the jar, as a bonus action on your turn or as a reaction when you take damage that doesn't reduce you to 0 hit points, you can shatter the jar and release its magic to protect yourself. This reduces your current hit points to 1, and until the end of your next turn you are immune to all damage and effects that would move you against your will, and are under the effects of the {@spell Antilife Shell} spell for that duration.

item.name: Sanctuary Rose
entries: This pale blue rose glows dimly, emitting 10 feet of dim light at all times and is surrounded by floating motes of light.

While holding the rose, on your turn (no action required) or as a reaction when you take damage that doesn't reduce you to 0 hit points, you can channel its magic to protect yourself. This reduces your current hit points to 1, and until the end of your next turn you are immune to all damage and effects that would move you against your will, and are under the effects of the {@spell Antilife Shell} spell for that duration.
Once this effect is used, the Rose must spend an hour in direct moonlight (under any moonphase except for new) before it can be used again.

item.name: Darkmoon Dhalia
entries: This dark purple flower emits a faint mist of dim light when held, suppressing any other light sources within a 30 foot radius and replacing that light with dim light.
Any creatures who take necrotic damage while in this dim light take an additional {@dice 1d6} necrotic damage.

item.name: Chalice of Light
entries: Once each day, this chalice can be used to pour out a vial's worth of {@item Holy Water (flask)|PHB|holy water}. This holy water becomes mundane water when the Chalice is used again.
As an action, the holy water can be drank to end the {@condition poisoned|PHB} condition or one disease afflicting the character.

Over the course of one minute, this vial can also be used to coat a weapon, granting it a +1 bonus to attack rolls and +1 radiant damage against fiends and undead. The coating lasts for one hour and for the duration the weapon is considered magical for the purposes of overcoming resistances.

item.name: Coin of Future Problems
entries: Once per day, you can hold onto this coin and hope for a little extra luck (no action required). You gain advantage on a roll (attack, ability check, or saving throw) when you do so. The next roll you make after that has disadvantage.

item.name: Shepherd Stones
entries: These three stones float around you at all times and attempt to protect you from harm. While attuned, when an attack is made that targets you, a sphere will intercept it and negate it. Once a sphere has intercepted an attack, it becomes inert and drops to the ground. Inert spheres recover once the user has completed a {@variantrule Long Rest}.
The spheres can be deactivated or reactivated as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. While deactivated, they do not intercept attacks.

item.name: Astral Teardrop
entries: You can fail an additional death saving throw before dying (4 total).

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You are immune to possession or mind control effects (such as {@spell Suggestion} or {@spell Dominate Person}).

item.name: Genie Vessel
entries: {@note This item could take several forms, such as an oil lamp, an urn, a ring with a compartment, or similar small container.}

While this tiny object is on your person, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} to vanish and enter the vessel, which remains in the space you left. The interior of the vessel is an extradimensional space in the shape of a 20-foot-radius cylinder, 20 feet high, and resembles your vessel. The interior is appointed with cushions and low tables and is a comfortable temperature. While inside, you can hear the area around your vessel as if you were in its space.

You can remain inside the vessel for a maximum of 10 hours. You exit the vessel early if you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to leave, if you die, or if the vessel is reduced to zero hit points. When you exit the vessel, you appear in the unoccupied space closest to it. Any objects left in the vessel remain there until carried out, and if the vessel is destroyed, every object stored there harmlessly appears in the unoccupied spaces closest to the vessel's former space.

The vessel has 18 AC, 45 hit points, and is immune to poison and psychic damage. When reduced to zero hit points, it becomes immune to all damage for one minute. If you do not pick it up and use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to repair it in this timeframe, it is destroyed. Once repaired, it regains all of its hit points.

item.name: Arrow of Acid

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} acid damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or become {@condition Melting|Starlight} until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Fire

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} fire damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Burning|Starlight}, repeating the saving throw at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

item.name: Arrow of Ice

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} cold damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target is {@condition Hampered|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Lightning

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} lightning damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. The target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Shocked|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Thunder

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition explodes, dealing {@dice 2d4} thunder damage to all creatures within 10 feet of the target. Any creature who takes this thunder damage must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be thrown 10 feet away from the target (the target is pushed directly away from you).
Huge or larger creatures have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on this saving throw.

item.name: Arrow of Gravity

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the ammunition explodes, and all creatures within 15 feet of the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 10 feet towards the target. If they cannot be moved the full 10 feet, they fall {@condition Prone|xphb} as well. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Slowed|Starlight}, and cannot jump, until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Piercing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the arrow deals half the damage of the original hit to the nearest creature up to 10 feet directly behind the original target.

item.name: Arrow of Binding

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the target must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or become {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by spectral ropes until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Wounding

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, causes the target to {@condition Bleeding|Starlight|Bleed}. At the end of each of their turns, they can make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw to end the condition.

item.name: Arrow of Maiming

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the start of your next turn. On a successful saving throw, they are {@condition Slowed|Starlight} instead.

item.name: Arrow of Curing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, this ammunition deals no damage, and instead clears the targets of any of the following conditions: {@condition Blinded|xphb}, {@condition Poisoned|xphb}, {@condition Paralysed|xphb}, {@condition Deafened|xphb}, {@condition Dazed|Starlight}, {@condition Disoriented|Starlight}, {@condition Weakened|Starlight}, {@condition Bleeding|Starlight}, {@condition Burning|Starlight}, {@condition Melting|Starlight}, {@condition Brittle|Starlight}, or {@condition Shocked|Starlight}.

item.name: Arrow of Disruption

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target loses {@status Concentration|XPHB} on any spell they are maintaining. Additionally, they must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Darkness

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, you cast the {@spell Darkness|xphb} spell on the target or target location. It lasts the full duration, not requiring concentration.

item.name: Arrow of Revealing

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the target becomes outlined in a glowing light, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 5-foot radius. This outline is visible through up to 10 feet of solid material, and lasts for 1 minute. While lit up this way, the target cannot benefit from the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Arrow of Dazzling

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

On hit, the arrow emits a flash of light. The target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} radiant damage and must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Lesser Slaying

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
If this arrow hits a Beast, Monstrosity, Undead, Humanoid, Construct, or Aberration, the attack is a critical hit.

item.name: Arrow of Weeping

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
On hit, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} necrotic damage and cannot regain any hit points until the start of your next turn.

item.name: Arrow of Greater Slaying

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
If this arrow hits a Dragon, Celestial, Elemental, Fiend, or Fey, the attack is a critical hit.

item.name: Arrow of Recurving

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

Hit or miss, you can make an attack against another target within 30 feet of the target (you cannot choose the same target more than once per arrow). You can do this up to two times, and you do not add your ability modifier to the damage roll of the additional attack(s).

item.name: Arrow of Relocation

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
You teleport to where this arrow lands.

item.name: Arrow of Explosives

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.

Hit or miss, this arrow explodes, forcing all creatures within 10 feet of the target to make a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC. On a failed saving throw, they take {@dice 4d4} fire damage and {@dice 4d4} force damage. On a successful saving throw, they take half the damage.

item.name: Nature's Emissary
entries: You have +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: As an action or in place of an attack when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can plant this sword in the ground to cause a special effect within a radius of 15 feet. You can change the benefit upon completing a long rest - which may alter its appearance.

Nature's Emissary stores a reservoir of energy with points equal to five times your character level. The reservoir is replenished each long rest. A benefit that requires the drawing of energy cannot be done without the required points.

entries.name: Spring's Rain
entries: The radius is filled with cool air a soothing mist. If a creature ends their turn within the radius, you may grant it up to 5 hit points, taking that many points from the reservoir.

entries.name: Fall's Warding
entries: The radius is filled with swirling leaves. Creatures within the area gain the benefit of half cover. This effect drains 5 points from the reservoir for each round it is planted there..

entries.name: Summer's Glory
entries: The radius is filled with warm air and bright light. If a creature starts its turn within the area, you may spend up to five points from the reservoir, increasing its movement speed by five times the number of points spent until the end of its turn. Additionally, you can spend five points and a reaction to grant a creature within the radius advantage on a saving throw it makes.

entries.name: Winter's Watch
entries: The radius becomes cold, and filled with dim light. Creatures within the area take less damage and healing from all sources, of an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. This effect drains 5 points from the reservoir for each round it is planted there.
You can pick up the sword as if it were lying on the floor to be picked up. Unattuned creatures must spend an action to do so.

item.name: Protector's Naginata
entries: This weapon is a polearm.
This weapon places you in the position of a corageous leader in battle. You have advantage on saving throws against the {@condition Frightened|phb} condition while wielding this weapon.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: When you kill a creature with this weapon, you can treat this as a +1 weapon against other creatures of its type. When the weapon is unattuned, it loses its memory.

{@note At the DM's discretion, 'of its type' may refer to species in the case of humanoids, drawing a distinction between elves, humanoids, dwarves, and so on. However, it is suggested that they be lenient, as this is just a +1 weapon.}

item.name: Sentinel's Rapier
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls using this weapon.
You gain a +1 bonus to initiative rolls.
While in combat, you deal an additional {@dice 1d6} necrotic damage with this weapon against creatures who have not taken a turn yet.

item.name: Jagged Followthrough
entries: You gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to attack and damage rolls with this weapon when you attack a target that is {@condition Bleeding|S: Conditions}.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: Once per short rest, you can make a special attack with this weapon that causes targets to {@condition Bleeding|S: Conditions|bleed} twice on hit. This can be used as an action, or in place of a normal weapon attack.

item.name: Threadsplitter
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls using this weapon.

entries.name: Wrath of Time
entries: This weapon deals an additional {@dice 1d4} force damage on each attack.

entries.name: Threadsplitter
entries: When you attack with advantage, if both rolls would hit the target, you roll the weapon's damage one additional time when determining the attack's damage. If you critically hit, this means that you roll the dice three times, not four.

entries.name: Eyes of Temporus
entries: You can cast the {@spell True Seeing|phb} spell once using this weapon. You regain the ability to do so after completing a long rest.

item.name: Clovehoof Armour
entries: Made from unusual fey materials, this armour is very light while still offering incredible protection. However, it is not more subtle than other similar armours.
You can add your full Dexterity modifier to your AC when wearing this medium armour.

item.name: Dragonspirit Robes
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: Your Ki save DC increases by 1, and once per long rest you may spent an action to regain a number of ki points equal to your wisdom modifier.

item.name: Vest of the Optimist
entries: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armour.
{@b All} creatures within 10 feet of you, including yourself, have vulnerability to piercing damage.

item.name: Timeless Scale-mail
entries: This scale-mail is made of the actual dragonscales of Temporus the Timekeeper, a time dragon.
You have +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armour, and you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Dexterity score of 16 or higher.

entries.name: Clarity
entries: You have advantage on any saving throw against the {@condition Dazed|Starlight} or {@condition Disoriented|Starlight} conditions.

entries.name: Immutable
entries: You gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to all saving throws while wearing this armour.

entries.name: Echoes in time
entries: You can sense which, if any, dragons were within 30 miles of your location within the last year.

item.name: Titanheart's Ring
entries: Creatures you restore hit points to gain a {@dice 1d4} bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, and are resistant to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, until the end of their next turn.

The titans are ancient creatures with many powerful magics at their disposal. Found at the bottom of a deep thermal well, this ring once belonged to Aurora, who tried and failed to protect her 'blasphemous' people from the pride-wounded revenge of Lycera, the glass goddess, in the storyland of Neverwhere.

item.name: Lunarvitra Arrow

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition gains a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. It is destroyed on use, dealing the weapon's ordinary damage (unless otherwise specified) and the additional effect below.
This arrow ignores bonuses to AC granted by spells or magical items, unless that spell or magical item is directly created by an Artifact or a Deity.

Targets hit by this arrow have any magical effects (such as {@spell Mage Armour|PHB} or {@spell Bestow Curse|PHB}) on them suppressed until the start of your next turn. Creatures with an antimagic susceptibility, such as {@creature Animated Armour|MM}, must follow the text in that condition, but only suffer its effects until the start of your next turn.
This arrow is made from fragments of the glass moon. It absorbs magic as it flies, temporarily suppressing spells and magical effects it comes into contact with.

item.name: Asha's Astral Teardrop
entries: You can fail an additional death saving throw before dying (4 total).

entries.name: Attunement
entries: You are immune to possession or mind control effects (such as {@spell Suggestion} or {@spell Dominate Person}). Once per long rest, you can cast {@spell Enervation|xge} or {@spell Modify Memory|phb}. If cast in this way, Modify Memory can affect a memory of any age, but only once on a given target.

The spirit of the first shadowmaiden, Asha, shed this tear when she was found in the Rifts. A gift to her daughter, it protects from death and from mental manipulation, ensuring that Anathema or Zintrin could never fall under the effects of the Ebon Blade again.

item.name: Fate's Pendant
entries: A sphere filled with shifting colours. When seen in your peripheral, it resembles an eye watching you.

entries.name: Redirect Fate.
entries: Once each long rest, you may reroll any attack, ability check, or saving throw that you make, using the new result.

entries.name: Attunement
entries: The Pendant carries {@dice 1d4-1} charges, which can be used to cast the {@spell Wish|phb} spell.
Additionally, when you use Redirect Fate, roll {@dice 4d6}. You may restore that many hit points, or deal that much necrotic damage, to a creature of your choice that you can see.

Fragments of the glass goddess' power are left all over Delamir - though this one is more intentional than her sunshard fragments. This pendant was a gift given to Scourge, the Master of Necromancy, as a reward for a service he did for the goddess. It was later stolen from his fortress by the Tempest Collective, who used it to free themselves from a pact with the goddess of the glass moon, and later to sever Anathema's connection to the Ebon Blade. Only two Wishes remained in it at the time, and it is unknown how the first was used.

item.name: Potionweaver's Bracelet
entries: As a {@action Magic} Action, you can load a potion into this bracelet. While wearing the bracelet, if you aren't {@condition Incapacitated}, you can administer the potion at a later time with no action required.
Alternatively, the potion can be delivered remotely at the cost of a {@variantrule Bonus Action} with a command word spoken by the ring's owner (not its bearer).

item.name: Blank Scroll
entries: The symbol of a dragon's head can be seen faintly on the reverse of the scroll.
If you spend one minute to read from this slightly-reflective scroll, you learn something about yourself, gaining one of the following benefits until the end of your next long rest:

items: Whenever you roll a hit die, roll it twice and choose the higher result.
Whenever you deal damage, no die can roll below a 3.
Whenever you heal a creature with a spell, increase the amount healed by {@dice 2d8}.
Whenever you take damage, 1 point is mitigated and reflected at your attacker instead.

entries: A creature can gain the benefit of this scroll only once.

item.name: Curious
entries: The exact appearance of this gem changes depending on your mood.
You can burn away this gem when you cast a spell to apply one of the following modifiers to it:

items: Cast the spell with no somatic or verbal components.
The target has disadvantage on its first saving throw against the spell.
The duration is doubled (to a maximum of 24 hours).
You can reroll any of the damage dice.
The range is doubled, or increased to 30 feet for a touch spell.
A casting time of one {@variantrule Action} becomes a casting time of one {@variantrule Bonus Action}.
You can protect any number of creatures from the spell's initial effects.

item.name: Cut Paper
entries: This paper is covered in folding lines, as if it was used for origami and unfolded many times.

You can place this sheet of paper against an object, then take the {@action Magic} action to cut a hole 1-foot deep anywhere that the paper is making contact with the object. You take 1 slashing damage and get a papercut at an inconvenient place on your hand. Once used, the paper loses its magic.

item.name: Engraving Quill
entries: This elegant quill can be used to write on any surface. Once used on any non-typical writing surface for a minute or more, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1, the quill snaps.

item.name: Exploding Nail Polish
entries: As a {@action Magic} Action, you can apply this bold red nail polish to a surface or willing creature. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action} you can speak the command word, chosen when you apply the polish, and deal {@damage 4d8} force damage to any creature within 10 feet of the bearer.
Alternatively, you can apply this to an object and speak the command word to make all nails in or connected to that object explode.
There is enough nail polish within the container for 3 applications.

item.name: Fisherman's Blanket
entries: This blanket is always slightly warm to the touch. It can be shaken dry with a {@action Magic} action.

item.name: Flamed Blade
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, you may activate this sword, causing it to burst into flame, dealing {@damage 1d4} additional fire damage for one minute. Once used, this property cannot be used again until the bearer completes a {@variantrule Long Rest}.

item.name: Healing Poultice
entries: You can spend one minute to apply this to a wounded character. After 30 minutes, they recover {@damage 8} hit points and regain two expended hit dice.
A creature that consumes this as an {@variantrule Action} takes {@damage 8} poison damage instead.

item.name: Hidden Dagger
entries: This dagger can be flawlessly concealed anywhere on your person, such as under the fold of a cloak. It can be found only by creatures with {@sense Truesight|XPHB}, who must succeed an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check against your Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}).

item.name: Hopeful Flame
entries: A flame that grows brighter with the attuned bearer's strength, found in the stump of a tree that has burned down.
As a {@action Magic} Action, you can summon the flame, which hovers near your head and casts 5 feet of bright light for each of your current hit dice. You may dismiss it as a {@action Magic} Action.
At the start of each of your turns, you may expend a hit die to gain the following benefits until the start of your next turn:

items: You are resistant to fire damage.
You may add the hit die expended to the damage roll of one weapon attack, as fire damage. You can choose to do so after the attack.

item.name: Ice Diamond
entries: A sealed box filled with crushed ice and a diamond worth 150GP. If removed from the ice, the diamond turns to a stone over 1 minute.

item.name: Invisibility Ring
entries: This ring is flawlessly invisible.

item.name: Lucky-Seven Rune
entries: Over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest}, you can apply this rune to a weapon. Attacks made with that weapon score a critical hit on a roll of 7, {@i instead} of 20.

item.name: Ring of Fire Detection
entries: This ring detects the presence of fire, with a range of touch.

item.name: Ring of Teleportation
entries: As a {@action Magic} Action, you can teleport this ring to an unoccupied location of your choice.

item.name: Potion of Greater Tealing
entries: This potion is a bright and cheery teal colour. On consumption, you regain {@damage 4d4+4} hit points and trigger a {@subclassFeature Wild Magic Surge|Sorcerer|XPHB|Wild Magic|XPHB|3|XPHB|wild magic surge}.

item.name: Potion of Hydration
entries: When consumed as a {@variantule Bonus Action}, this potion flawlessly quenches your thirst.

item.name: Pulpy Healing Potion
entries: This healing potion is off-putting in that it is thick, pulpy, and an oddly dark shade of red. When drunk or administered to an adjacent creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, it restores {@damage 2d4+2} hit points.

item.name: Ring of Inn Visibility
entries: Makes available to you, an inn where you may reside for up to 24 hours, and purchase a range of magical liqueurs and items, and basic supplies, as determined by the DM.

You can open the spectral doorway to the inn by focusing on the ring for ten minutes. Only creatures you can choose can follow you through it. If you are within the inn at the end of the 24 hours, you are ejected from it in the space you entered it. Once the ring is used, it fades away and vanishes.

item.name: Scroll of Weather Detection
entries: Tells you what the weather is in a location of your choice. If it's raining where you are, the scroll disintegrates immediately and doesn't tell you what the weather is.
Roll a {@dice d100}. If you roll below 10, you hear ominous whispers foretelling your death.

item.name: Solemn Silver Ring
entries: A silver ring with a phrase written in Celestial engraved on its inside, reading 'gone, but not forgotten'.
If a creature dies whilst wearing this ring, their last moments are stored within it and can appear as a vivid memory to the ring's wearer, when they put it on and voluntarily after that.

item.name: Spell-storing Arrow
entries: You can cast a spell into this arrow and apply its effect on hitting a creature, replacing the arrow's damage if you so choose. If the spell requires {@status Concentration|XPHB}, you do not have to concentrate on it. The spell cannot have a range of self, and its effect will originate on the target creature.
Once used, the arrow turns to ash.

item.name: Wand of Mystery
entries: This spell focus has seven charges. The way in which the charges are expended is determined by the DM in secret. Once all seven charges are expended, a genie appears to grant you a limited wish - an effect of your choice interpreted as the genie pleases. As a guideline, the power of the request should be no more impactful than a 6th level spell.

item.name: Volatile Earth Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}
On the space you target, a large wall appears. It is 10 feet high, 5 feet thick, and has AC 15 and HP 25. It is immune to psychic and poison damage. The wall lasts for 10 minutes or until destroyed.

item.name: Volatile Gravity Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}
Gravity is increased or decreased (your choice) for the target struck. The target takes double or half damage from falling, their jump distance is halved or doubled, until the end of your next turn.
If you increase the gravity, the target cannot fly until the effect ends.

item.name: Volatile Ice Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}

A 10-foot square ice path appears on the surface struck with this ammunition. The area lasts for one minute. The area is difficult terrain, and any creature that enters, starts its turn on, or is benefitting from the {@action Dash|XPHB} action on the surface must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

item.name: Volatile Air Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}

Air erupts from the target struck. All creatures within 10 feet of the target must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the target (the target, if possible, is pushed 10 feet directly away from you on a failed saving throw).
Alternatively, fire this shell to recoil yourself 10 feet in the opposite direction shot. If this leaves you airborne, you fall only at the end of your turn unless you choose to fall sooner.

item.name: Volatile Nature Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}
Immediately grow an area of plants in a 20-foot square on the surface struck with this ammunition. The area lasts for 10 minutes. The area requires 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot moved.
Alternatively, fire this shell at a specific plant to cause it to grow dramatically. Creatures in the plant's way are moved harmlessly aside by the growth, which is determined by the DM.

item.name: Volatile Lightning Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}
You supercharge a mechanical construct, increasing its speed or power for one turn. The exact effect is determined by the DM. Some examples are listed below.

items: A construct is given the benefit of the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell until the end of its next turn. Instead of lethargy when the spell ends, it could instead gain a temporary level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}, removed on a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.
A construct can take an immediate {@variantrule Action|XPHB} using its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.
A machine or trap activates immediately.
The speed of a construct is doubled for one round.

item.name: Volatile Thunder Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This ammunition is worth 15gp, and can be crafted in just one day with {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}. A full loader, 6 shots, can be crafted in one downtime period.}

A deafening sound erupts from the target space. Objects within 20 feet of the target take {@dice 3d8} Thunder damage, and creatures within that range are {@condition Deafened|XPHB} until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Contained Thunder Shell

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: This magic ammunition deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.

Your shot is silent and creates a 20-foot radius sphere of sonic force, suppressing all noise that would pass through it and {@condition Deafened|XPHB|Deafening} all creatures while they are in the area. The area lasts for 1 minute.

item.name: Prismatic Loader

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: Magic ammunition contained within this loader deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
Each shell in this loader deals no damage as part of the attack and instead causes a random magical effect to occur on the target, determined on the {@dice d20} table below.

entries.caption: Wild Magic Effect
rows: The target gains +5 to one ability score of its choice, and -5 to another, for the next minute.
The target gains the 'Enlarge' effect of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} spell, without requiring {@status Concentration|XPHB}.
For the next minute, the target gains 5 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns.
The target has the benefit of the {@spell Haste|XPHB} spell until the end of its next turn. It does not suffer the lethargy when the spell ends.
The target becomes {@condition Invisible|XPHB} for ten minutes, or until makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or deals damage.
The next time the target casts a spell in the next minute, it requires a spell slot one level lower than normal.
The first time the target deals damage before the start of its next turn, it uses the highest number on each damage die instead of rolling.
On its next turn, the target can use its {@variantrule Action|XPHB|Actions} and {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB|Bonus Actions} interchangeably.
The target gains the benefit of the {@spell Shield of Faith|XPHB} spell, not requiring {@status Concentration|XPHB}, for 1 minute.

The target emits {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 30-foot radius for the next minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the target is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.
The next time the target would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in the next hour, it is instead reduced to a number of Hit Points equal to twice its level.
The target becomes immune to the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} or {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition (its choice) for the next 10 minutes.
The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is increased by 20 feet for the next hour.
The target can immediately teleport to an unoccupied space it can see within 60 feet of itself.

A small mote of light orbits the target's head. When it fails a {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}, it can snuff the light to add {@dice 1d12} to the roll, ending the effect. The light disappears naturally after one hour.

The target regains 5 {@variantrule Hit Dice|XPHB}. It can also expend and roll up to 5 Hit Dice, adding its Constitution modifier to each, and regaining {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total rolled. If it would benefit the creature, it can expend them first and then regain the Hit Dice.
The target gains {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage until the start of your next turn.

The target casts a random spell, which doesn't require {@status Concentration|XPHB} if it normally would. Roll {@dice 1d10} to determine the spell: on a 1, {@spell Confusion|XPHB}; on a 2, {@spell Fireball|XPHB}; on a 3, {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB}; on a 4, {@spell Fly|XPHB} (cast on a random creature within 60 feet of you), on a 5, {@spell Grease|XPHB}; on a 6, {@spell Levitate|XPHB} (cast on yourself); on a 7, {@spell Magic Missile|XPHB} (cast as a level 5 spell); on an 8, {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB}; on a 9, {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} (cast on yourself), and if you fail the saving throw, you turn into a {@creature Goat|XMM}; on a 10, {@spell See Invisibility|XPHB}.
The target can make one {@action Attack|XPHB}, or cast a Cantrip, immediately (no action required).

You and the target regain {@dice 2d10} hit points, and recover one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower. If there is no spell slot, an equivalent resource can be gained: for example, 5 {@classFeature Monk's Focus|Monk|XPHB|2|XPHB|Focus Points}, {@classFeature Font of Magic|Sorcerer|XPHB|2|XPHB|Sorcery Points}, or {@classFeature Instinct|Hunter|Starlight|1|Starlight}. For more limited resources, regain one, such as {@classFeature Second Wind|Fighter|XPHB|1|XPHB}, {@classFeature Action Surge|Fighter|XPHB|2|XPHB}, {@classFeature Rage|Barbarian|XPHB|1|XPHB}, {@classFeature Wild Shape|Druid|XPHB|2|XPHB}, or {@classFeature Channel Divinity|Cleric|XPHB|2|XPHB}.

item.name: Aberrant Loader

entries.name: Magic Ammunition
entries: Magic ammunition contained within this loader deals the weapon's normal damage to the target unless otherwise specified.
{@note This Loader is worth 200gp, and so can be crafted in one week of downtime for 100gp, using {@item Jeweller's Tools|XPHB}.}
Each shell in this loader deals no damage as part of the attack and instead causes a random magical effect to occur on the target, determined on the {@dice d20} table below.

entries.caption: Wild Magic Effect
rows: The target becomes doused in {@item Oil|XPHB}.
{@item Hunting Trap|XPHB|Hunting Traps} appear in all the spaces surrounding the creature.
A {@spell Fireball|XPHB} spell is cast on the target or target location.
The target is {@condition Slowed|Starlight} until the end of its next turn.
The target becomes {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by a {@item Net|XPHB}.
The target must succeed a DC 15 Charisma saving throw or be {@spell Polymorph|XPHB|Polymorphed} into a {@creature Frog|XMM} until the end of your next turn.
The target disappears into the Astral Plane, and reappears at the end of its next turn in the space it left, or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
The target is {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.
The target glitters, suffering the effects of the {@spell Faerie Fire|XPHB} spell. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw to end the effect.
The target and up to 2 creatures of your choice within 20 feet of it take {@dice 3d10} lightning damage.
A flash of light causes the target and all creatures within 10 feet of it to become {@condition Blinded} until the start of your next turn.
The target and all creatures within 10 feet of it have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to Piercing damage for the next minute.
The target is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the end of its next turn.
The target becomes {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}. At the end of each of its turns, it can make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, ending the condition on a success.
The target teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see, of your choosing.
The first time the target deals damage before the start of your next turn, it uses the lowest possible number on each die instead of rolling.
The target becomes {@condition Burning|Starlight}, {@condition Rattled|Starlight}, {@condition Melting|Starlight}, and {@condition Brittle|Starlight} until the end of your next turn.
The target takes {@dice 2d10} necrotic damage, and you regain that many hit points.
The target has {@variantrule Disadvantage} on the next saving throw it makes.
The target falls {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage.

item.name: Spell-Storing Sunshard
entries: This sunshard may have a short description related to its contained spell.

This sunshard contains a spell, which will also influence its colour, and rarity. For example, an indigo sunshard could contain any arcane (wizard) spell, yellow for divine (cleric, paladin), and green for primal (druid/ranger) spells. But this could vary by the specific spell.

A spell cast through a sunshard is treated as if it was cast by the person wielding the sunshard, including concentration but excluding other requirements for the spell, such as material components. Typical rarities of the shards can be seen below.

item.name: Red Sunshard of Recovery
entries: This sunshard is empowered with positive energy, and hums quietly at all times.
As a bonus action, you can draw the power from the shard and direct it at a creature within 60 feet of you. For the next minute, that creature regains 2 hit points at the start of each of its turns.

item.name: Red Sunshard of Bursting
entries: This sunshard is positively bursting at the seams, and its edges glow brighter than the rest.

As an action, you can crush this shard in your hand to release the energy stored within it. Every creature within 10 feet of you gains {@dice 1d4+3} hit points. If they are below one quarter of their hit point maximum, this healing is doubled.

item.name: Red Sunshard of Purity
entries: This sunshard makes you feel calmer when you hold it.

As an action, you take the power from the shard and emit a brilliant aura with a radius of 20 feet for one minute. Allies within the aura have advantage on Wisdom saving throws. Additionally, you can choose one of the following effects, which require your concentration:

items: You may spend a bonus action on each of your turns to restore {@dice 2d4} hitpoints to a creature of your choice within the aura.
Any creature of your choice within the aura gains the maximum possible number of hit points from any healing.

item.name: Orange Sunshard of Ignition
entries: This orange sunshard is warm to the touch.

As a bonus action, you can shatter the sunshard in your grip, setting yourself alight with warding flame. Any creature that hits you with a melee attack in the next minute suffers {@dice 1d4} fire damage in retaliation. Additionally, you can set any flammable objects you touch ablaze, and you emit 10 feet of bright light and a further 10 feet of dim light.

item.name: Orange Sunshard of Eruption
entries: This sunshard rumbles and shakes in your hands, causing a mild discomfort over time.
As an action, you can cause an opaque wall of fire to erupt from the ground at a point within 30 feet of you. The wall is 1 foot thick, 20 feet long, and lasts until the end of your next turn.

Any creatures within its space must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or take {@dice 4d8} fire damage. Any creature who enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends their turn there takes the same damage.

item.name: Orange Sunshard of Searing
entries: This sunshard leaves faint marks on your hand if held for ten minutes, which swirl slowly in place until fading over a few minutes.
As a bonus action, you can expend this sunshard's power, forcing a creature within 60 feet of you to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the creature is marked for one hour. They cannot benefit from invisibility, emit 5 feet of bright light and a further 5 feet of dim light.

When the creature is marked, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target loses resistance to that damage type, and once per turn when they take damage of the chosen type, takes an additional {@dice 1d8} damage of the chosen type.

item.name: Yellow Sunshard of Dim Light
entries: This small sunshard is imbued with ambient energy and glows with 10 feet of dim light at all times.

As an action, you can cause this sunshard to shine as brightly as a {@item torch|phb} for one hour. After that time, roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 1, it burns out, otherwise it returns to its ambient magic at the next dawn.

item.name: Yellow Sunshard of Searing Radiance
entries: This small sunshard is painful to look at for an extended period of time.

As an action, you can eject the light from the sunshard in a flash of brilliance. Roll {@dice 2d6}. Any hostile creatures within 30 feet of you must succeed a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for one turn and take that much damage. You gain that many temporary hit points.

item.name: Yellow Sunshard of Positive Force
entries: This sunshard emits 5 feet of bright daylight, and a further 5 feet of dim light, at all times.

As an action, you can emit a beam of pure positive energy forward. Any creatures of your choice in a 60-foot long, 5-foot wide line must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition blinded} until the start of your next turn, and take {@dice 8d6} radiant damage. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and are not blinded. Undead have disadvantage on the saving throw.
Any other creatures of your choice regain {@dice 4d8} hit points.

item.name: Green Sunshard of Erupting Earth
entries: This sunshard is quite heavy, and can be treated as a simple melee weapon, which is magical and does {@dice 1d4} bludgeoning damage.
As an action, you can throw the sunshard a distance in feet up to 3 times your strength score. If it lands on solid ground, the earth beneath it erupts upwards in a 15 foot cube centred on it.
Any creature within that space is pushed to the nearest side and takes {@dice 3d8} bludgeoning damage, and the cube is filled with nine walls of earth and stone.
Each wall occupies a 5 foot square and is 15 feet tall, has AC 15 and 35 hit points.
If a generated wall would not fit within the space, it is not summoned.

item.name: Green Sunshard of Lesser Air
entries: This crystal has a faint and gentle green hue; inside it slowly swirls a small cloud

As an action, you can expend the magic in the shard, casting the {@spell gust of wind} spell, concentrating on it as normal. Alternatively, you can store the magic within yourself: for up to an hour, while you do this you do not need to breathe.
Ending this early (for example, to speak) offers you no other benefit. Expending the magic leaves the shard empty and dull.

item.name: Green Sunshard of Unnatural Growth
entries: Leaves and blossom occasionally grow on the outside of this sunshard, which bloom into small lotuses after a day.
As an action, you can draw the power from this sunshard to within yourself, gaining the following benefits for 2 hours:

items: You can talk to plants, as with the {@spell speak with plants} spell.

You can cause a plant to grow extremely rapidly, for example, turning a sapling into a tree, or a tree branch into a solid walkway. It takes one minute to cause something to grow 30 feet, which requires your action to do each turn, as if casting a spell. You cannot grow the same object more than once.
You can cast the {@spell plant growth} spell once without expending a spell slot, and you know the spell for the duration.
You can cast the {@spell guardian of nature} once without expending a spell slot, and you know the spell for the duration.

item.name: Blue Sunshard of Energising
entries: This sunshard crackles delicately in your hand, as small sparks of lightning jolt between its vertices.
As a bonus action, you can crush this sunshard in your hands to immediately gain the benefits of a Short Rest, and one level of exhaustion.

item.name: Blue Sunshard of Javelin Lightning
entries: This sunshard gives anyone who touches it a static shock, if it hasn't been held for more than one minute. A creature resistant to lightning damage does not receive this shock.

When you take the attack action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an attack with this sunshard, if you are holding it or able to draw it. The sunshard deals {@dice 4d8} lightning damage on a hit and has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 60/120).

If the target is made of or wearing metal, you have advantage on the attack roll. On a hit, the target must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they are stunned until the start of your next turn. On a miss, the following effect still applies, centred on the target.
Additionally, any creatures within 20 feet of the target must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@dice 2d8} lightning damage, or half as much on a successful one.

Once used, the sunshard is expended and reduced to nothingness. If the attack was a miss, the sunshard remains, empty, and you can attempt a DC 20 Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) check to restore its magic. On a fail, the magic is lost permanently.

item.name: Blue Sunshard of Stormcalling
entries: This sunshard naturally draws lightning and electricity towards itself. While it is on your person, you have disadvantage on saving throws you make against effects that deal lightning damage.
As a ten-minute ritual, you can change the weather outside to thunderstorms, regardless of what it was initially, which will persist for one day.
After casting this ritual, you gain resistance to lightning and thunder damage, or immunity to those damage types if you are already resistant.
You can cast {@spell Call Lightning} at will, so long as you are outside under the storm you summoned. Once the storm ends, you lose this ability.

item.name: Indigo Sunshard of Projection
entries: As an action, you can break this sunshard to summon a protective ward for you and your allies. The ward has hit points equal to twice your level plus your intelligence modifier. Whenever you take damage, the ward takes it instead. If this damage reduces the ward to zero hit points, the damage is lost.
While the ward is active, you can spend a reaction to reduce the damage taken by a creature of your choice within 30 feet of you, with the ward taking the damage instead.

item.name: Indigo Sunshard of Fuelling
entries: This sunshard feels as though it is filled with sand or dust, though visibly it is solid crystal.

This sunshard can be used to replace 50gp of material spell components for any spell, or for a material component with no listed cost that you do not possess. It can be used in this way only once, upon which it will disappear, being replaced with a fine-grained indigo dust.

item.name: Indigo Sunshard of Warding
entries: It is difficult to hold this sunshard: as if two opposing magnets were placed in it and your hand.

As a reaction, you can crush this sunshard to negate the effect of one attack or spell entirely, so long as it targets only you, and if the attacker is within 10 feet of you, push them 10 feet in a direction of your choice.

item.name: Violet Sunshard of Repulsion
entries: This violet sunshard is surprisingly heavy for its size.

As an action, you can expel the magic from this shard. A burst of force erupts from the shard and detonates at a point you can see within 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or take {@dice 2d8} force damage and be moved 10 feet away from the detonation point. On a successful save, they take half the damage and are not moved.

item.name: Violet Sunshard of Grounding
entries: This sunshard weighs more the higher it is from the ground.

As a bonus action, you can throw this sunshard to a point within 30 feet of you, shattering it and creating an area with a radius of 15 feet. Any creatures within the area have their movement speed halved, and take {@dice 2d6} force damage at the end of their turn if they remain in the area.
If any creatures are airborne when this area is generated, they must make a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be pulled down to the ground, taking twice as much fall damage.

item.name: Violet Sunshard of Altered Gravity
entries: The weight of this sunshard depends on your mood.

You may spend an action, and this sunshard, to target a creature within 30 feet of you. That target must succeed a DC 13 Charisma saving throw or their gravity be altered in one of the following ways.

items: Their gravity becomes heavy. They cannot jump, their movement speed is halved, and they have disadvantage on dexterity checks and saving throws. Additionally, they take twice as much damage from falling.

Their gravity becomes light. Their jump height is doubled, forced movement affects them twice as strongly, and they have disadvantage on strength checks and saving throws. Additionally, they take half as much damage from falling.

entries: The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending it on a success.

item.name: White Sunshard of Deferred Action
entries: This sunshard moves half a second after you move it.
As an action, you can crush this sunshard in your hand. The temporal sand it turns into slows you, ending your turn. Next turn, you may take an additional action, or an additional bonus action.

item.name: White Sunshard of Held Energy
entries: The visual position of the sunshard only changes when its owner blinks. The sunshard otherwise remains with you at all times.

As a reaction, you can direct the shard's power towards an effect or spell that targets an area that you can see. Before the end of your next turn, you can release the effect, at which point it will occur targeting the same area as it originally did. You must release the effect before the end of your next turn.
The effect is released early if the target point has total cover from you, or if you are {@condition incapacitated} or die.

item.name: White Sunshard of Skipped Time
entries: On your turn, you may draw the power from this shard (no action required) to leave time temporarily. Other creatures act as if you are still there while you are gone. Any time before the end of your next turn, you may reenter the timestream.

While you are out of the timestream, you cannot take damage, you can move freely in any direction, and you may choose to end any conditions affecting you. However, you cannot damage or affect other creatures in any way.

At a point of your choosing, you can interrupt another creature's turn, appearing in a place of your choice that is within your movement speed and taking an additional turn then. When you interrupt a creature, that creature is {@condition Marked|Starlight|Marked (4)} and {@condition Exposed|Starlight} until the end of your turn, as they are surprised by your sudden appearance.
If you have not interrupted a creature before the start of your next turn, you reenter time then in a space of your choice and take your time as normal.

item.name: Black Sunshard of Absorption
entries: When unwell, the shard is physically difficult to remove from your hand.
As an action, you can draw any toxins within yourself into this crystal. You can end any number of poisons or diseases affecting you. For the next hour, you have resistance to poison damage.

item.name: Black Sunshard of Clouding
entries: This sunshard constantly emits wisps of dark smoke.

As an action, you can crush this shard in your hands, and cast {@spell Darkness|phb|}, targeted on yourself. Alternatively, you can throw the shard at a point within 20 feet for the same effect, targeted where it lands.
Any creature that starts or ends its turn in the darkness must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become {@condition poisoned} until the end of their next turn.

item.name: Black Sunshard of Crippling
entries: This sunshard always appears as its own silhouette.

As an action, you can crush this shard in your hands and direct its energy at a creature within 60 feet. That creature must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or take {@dice 8d8|} necrotic damage and become {@condition dazed|Starlight} until the end of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half the damage and are not dazed.
Until the target takes a short rest, their movement speed is halved, and they cannot recover any hit points, including as part of the short rest.

spell.name: Earth Shock
entries: You channel the earth's might to suppress another creature. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage and is {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|1-9|1d4} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Frost Shock

components.m: An drop of water or an ice cube

entries: You conjure a mote of pure cold and launch it at your target. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d4} cold damage and must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it is {@condition Slowed|Starlight} instead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 2d4|1-9|1d4} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Vitality Hex

components.m: A used match, torch, or lantern

entries: You weave a cloak of shadow over a target's lifeforce. The target takes {@damage 2d8} necrotic damage becomes hexed for the duration of the spell. While hexed, once on each turn when the target takes damage (including from the casting of this spell), you regain {@damage 1d6} hit points. The target can make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the healing gained increases to {@damage 2d6} and any damage the target takes is increased by {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage.

spell.name: Primordial Spark
entries: You conjure a wisp of primordial magic and launch it at a creature or object within range. Choose on effect from the options below. You make an attack roll, dealing {@dice 1d8} damage of the chosen type and gaining the additional benefit specified.

entries.name: Searing Flame (Fire)
entries: If you roll an 8 on a {@dice d8} for this spell, you can roll another and add it to the damage. The maximum number of dice added this way equals your spellcasting ability modifier.

entries.name: Ancient Frost (Cold)
entries: Treat any roll below 3 on the {@dice d8}s for this spell as a 3.

entries.name: Disruptive Spark (Lightning)
entries: The target cannot take a {@variantrule Reaction} until the end of your current turn.

entries.name: Reverberating Thunder (Thunder)
entries: The target is {@condition Deafened}.

entries.name: Splashing Acid (Acid)
entries: The target's space(s) becomes filled with acid that deals 1d8 damage to the next creature who enters it.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d8} when you reach levels 5 ({@dice 2d8}), 11 ({@dice 3d8}), and 17 ({@dice 4d8}).

spell.name: Primordial Eruption

m.text: A chunk of obsidian worth at least 50gp

entries: An elemental disturbance causes the ground to split. Choose one effect from the options below. Creatures within a 15-foot cube that originates at a point of your choosing on the ground must make a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} damage of the chosen type and suffer the chosen effect. Creatures take half as much damage on a successful save.

entries.name: Molten Earth (Fire)
entries: Lava sprays upwards. Creatures who failed the saving throw fall {@condition Prone}. Prone creatures within the area take an additional {@damage 1d8} fire damage.

entries.name: Frozen Fissure (Cold)
entries: Creatures that fail the saving throw are {@condition Restrained} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Fulminant Fault (Lightning)
entries: The speed at which the eruption occurs leaves creatures who fail the saving throw {@condition Staggered|Starlight} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Seismic Burst (Thunder)
entries: Creatures who fail the saving throw are pushed 15 feet away from the centre of the cube and fall {@condition Prone}.

entries.name: Caustic Vent (Acid)
entries: Creatures who move through the area take {@damage 1d8} acid damage for each 5 feet moved. This effect disappears at the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At higher levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d8} for each slot level above 2.

spell.name: Primordial Breath

m.text: A mint plant in a pot worth at least 100gp

entries: You unleash a flash of raw elemental force. Choose one effect from the options below. Creatures within a 30-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 7d6} damage of the chosen type and suffer the additional effect specified below. On a successful save, targets take half as much damage.

entries.name: Pyroclastic Smoke (Fire)
entries: Creatures who fail the saving throw become {@condition Blinded} until they or an adjacent ally clears the condition with a {@variantrule Bonus Action}.

entries.name: Flash Freeze (Cold)
entries: Creatures who fail the saving throw are {@condition Halted} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Ionising Breath (Lightning)
entries: Creatures who fail the saving throw cannot take a {@variantrule Bonus Action} on their next turn.

entries.name: Pressure Wave (Thunder)
entries: All creatures in the area are pushed 10 feet away from you.

entries.name: Acidic Deluge (Acid)
entries: Creatures in the area take an additional 3d6 acid damage at the end of their next turn unless they use an {@variantrule Action} to wipe the acid from themselves.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At higher levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each slot level above 3.

spell.name: Primordial Cloudburst

m.text: A lapis stone worth at least 150gp

entries: You call forth a cloud of energy that fills the area beneath it with an elemental effect. Choose one effect from the options below. Creatures within a 30-foot radius, 40-foot tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on a point within range must make a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 8d6} damage of the chosen type. On a success, they take half the damage only. The area is then filled with the chosen effect until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Scalding Water (Fire)
entries: Creatures ending their turn within the area become {@condition Burning|Starlight}.

entries.name: Sleet Rain (Cold)
entries: The area is filled with a thick mist and is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB}.

entries.name: Stormclouds (Lightning)
entries: The air is filled with static electricity; creatures cannot take {@variantrule Reaction|Reactions} within the area.

entries.name: Thunderclouds (Thunder)
entries: Creatures are {@condition Silenced|Starlight} while in the area.

entries.name: Acid Rain (Acid)
entries: Creatures attacking from within the area take {@damage 1d6} damage whenever they attack.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At higher levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 4.

spell.name: Primordial Spire

m.text: A stone model of a tower worth at least 200gp

entries: You summon an ancient monolith imbued with an elemental power chosen from the options below. The monolith has a radius of 20 feet and a height of up to 60 feet, filling any height lower than that. Creatures in the way of the monolith can choose to make a Dexterity saving throw to be placed at the edge of the area, otherwise they remain on top. If there is not space on top for the creature, they are crushed for {@damage 4d10} bludgeoning damage and then dropped outside of the area

entries.name: Pillar of Flame (Fire)
entries: Creatures who end their turn within 10 feet of the monolith take {@damage 6d8} fire damage, objects not being worn or carried ignite. This monolith can be travelled through; it provides 3/4 cover to creatures in or on the other side of it and is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fang of Ice (Cold)
entries: Creatures who end their turn within 10 feet of this solid monolith take {@damage 5d8} cold damage and are {@condition Hampered|Starlight} until the end of their next turn.

entries.name: Obelisk of Storms (Lightning)
entries: Lightning is drawn towards this solid mineral spire. Creatures who start their turn within 10 feet of the spire can take an {@variantrule Action} or {@variantrule Bonus Action} on their turn, not both. Additionally, when a creature takes lightning damage while near the spire, it is increased by {@damage 2d8}.

entries.name: Spire of Echoes (Thunder)
entries: Resonations from this stone spire amplify sound. Creatures of your choice within 20 feet of the spire are vulnerable to Thunder damage. Creatures casting spells while within 20 feet of the spire have advantage on any attack rolls made as part of that spell.

entries.name: Thorn of Nox (Acid)
entries: If a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of the spire, it is {@condition Hampered|Starlight} and attack and damage rolls are reduced by {@dice 1d6} until the start of its next turn, and attack and damage rolls made against it are increased by {@dice 1d6} for the same duration.

spell.name: Primordial Tempest
entries: You conjure an ancient storm in the form of a 30-foot radius, 60-foot-tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder}, centred on a point within range, which moves 20 feet in a direction of your choice at the start of each of your turns. Choose one effect from the options below. Creatures who enter the tempest or start their turn in it must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 6d10} damage of the chosen type, taking half as much on a success. The tempest also applies the chosen affect within its area for the duration.

entries.name: Superheated Winds (Fire)
entries: Objects that are not worn or carried ignite. Creatures within the area have disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries.name: White Gale (Cold)
entries: Dense snow makes the area {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|XPHB} and {@condition Hampered|Starlight|Hampers} creatures who start their turn in it until the end of their turn.

entries.name: Static Storm (Lightning)
entries: At the start of each of your turns, choose a creature within the storm to be struck by lightning. It must succeed an additional Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 3d10} lightning damage

entries.name: Howling Squall (Thunder)
entries: Creatures within are {@condition Deafened} and {@condition Silenced|Starlight}.

entries.name: Toxic Fumes (Acid)
entries: Creatures within the tempest cannot benefit from any damage resistances, and their immunities are treated as resistances.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At higher levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 4.

spell.name: Divine Shield
entries: You bestow a divine boon on a creature, protecting it from harm.

The first time a creature would take damage while under the effects of this spell, they instead take none. If an effect deals multiple damage types simultaneously, the creature is protected from all of them.
The spell ends after protecting a creature once, or if the target completes a long rest.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Holy Nova
entries: Divine light surges forth from you. You may choose any 6 creatures within a 30-foot radius, centered on you.

Creatures you choose gain a Divine Shield, as with the {@spell Divine Shield|S:Spells} spell. Any remaining creatures must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 6d6} radiant damage, or half as much on a successful save. The divine light harmlessly washes over every other creature.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 6d6|4-9|1d6} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Consecrate

components.m: a weapon or staff worth at least 1sp

entries: You strike, or plant your weapon into, the ground, sending ripples of force through it. Any creature touching the same surface within a 50-foot cone (the spell covers up to 10 feet of elevation changes (such as a small wall or hole), but is blocked by a break in the surface) must make a Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 10d4} radiant damage and fall {@condition prone|phb}. On a successful save, they take half damage and do not fall {@condition prone|phb}.

Celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on the saving throw. Furthermore, the ground within the spell's area is considered difficult terrain for those creature types for the next minute.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot above 4th level, the damage increases by {@scaledamage 10d4|4-9|1d4} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Arcane Butterflies
entries: A 20 foot cube within range is briefly filled with a burst of glowing spectral butterflies. Creatures within the area must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 2d8} psychic damage and must use all of their movement in a random direction on their turn. On a successful save, they take half as much damage and do not have to use their movement randomly.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell with a spell slot above 2nd level, the spell increases by {@scaledamage 2d8|1-9|1d8} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Raelynn's Purification Aura
entries: A 30-foot radius area around you is filled with purifying energy pulled from the warmth of the stars. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. Each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) can't become diseased and has resistance to poison damage.

Furthermore, those creatures have advantage on saving throws against effects that cause any of the following conditions: {@condition blinded}, {@condition charmed}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, {@condition stunned}, {@condition dazed|S: Conditions}, {@condition disoriented|S: Conditions}, {@condition shocked|S: Conditions}, {@condition bleeding|S: Conditions} and {@condition weakened|S: Conditions}.
