spell.name: Raelynn's Lesser Restoration
entries: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be {@condition blinded}, {@condition deafened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition poisoned}, {@condition dazed|S: Conditions}, {@condition disoriented|S: Conditions}, {@condition silenced|S: Conditions}, or {@condition weakened|S: Conditions}.

spell.name: Pixie Sparks
entries: You conjure a volley of disorienting Feywild sparks to assail a creature. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6} psychic damage and the next attack made against it before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d6}), 11 ({@damage 3d6}), and 17 ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Stellar Omen
entries: You read a brief omen from the stars. Roll a {@damage d4}. You can add or subtract that roll to or from any {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} made by a creature within 30 feet of you within the next round.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The distance at which you can affect a creature increases by 30 feet at 5th level (60 feet), 11th level (90 feet), and 17th level (120 feet).

spell.name: Celestial Mark
entries: Mark a creature with a celestial sign. The target is marked by fate and must make an Intelligence saving throw or take {@damage 1d6} radiant damage.
While marked, attack rolls against the target have a {@dice 1d6} bonus. This mark lasts until the target is hit with an attack or until one minute passes.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach levels 5 ({@damage 2d6}), 11 ({@damage 3d6}), and 17 ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Parallax Shift

time.condition: which is taken when you see a creature within 30 feet make an attack

entries: You shift a creature along the cosmic gradient, shifting them towards or away from their goal. Choose one of the following:
{@b Blueshift.} The creature makes an additional attack.
{@b Redshift.} The creature's attack is negated: a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} becomes a normal hit, and a normal hit becomes a miss.

spell.name: Bias Fate
entries: The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed saving throw, fate leans against it: attacks made against it have a {@dice 1d4} bonus to the attack roll; when it forces a creature to make a saving throw, that creature adds {@dice 1d4} to the saving throw; and whenever it makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, it subtracts {@dice 1d4} from the result.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: You can target one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1.

spell.name: Starlike Skim
entries: You temporarily take on a form of starlight, becoming pale and translucent. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits:

You gain 15 feet of movement speed. You can pass through other creatures' spaces, move over liquid and non-solid surfaces harmlessly (but not stand on them), and your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.
As part of casting the spell, you end any effects on you that cause you to be {@condition Grappled|XPHB}.

spell.name: Follow the Stars
entries: You see the celestial patterns of the sky and allow them to guide you in the right direction over long distances.

{@b Choice.} Whenever you encounter a meaningful choice of direction, you can spend a moment observing your surroundings. Choose one of the following traits, the DM reveals which of the routes forward most fits that criteria: safest, fastest, most direct, or the path with the most reward.

{@b Navigation.} While you can see the night sky: you and your immediate allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any Wisdom ({@skill Survival}) checks made on your journey, and moving at a fast pace does not affect your Wisdom ({@skill Perception} or {@skill Survival}) or Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks.

spell.name: Starfire
entries: You channel a fraction of a star's light into an unstoppable celestial lance. Choose a creature, it and all other creatures in a 5-foot wide line between you and that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. This effect ignores 1/2 or 3/4 cover.

On a failed save, each creature takes {@damage 3d10} radiant damage and becomes {@condition Burning|Starlight}, the chosen creature taking an additional {@damage 3d10} fire damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and does not start Burning .

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The radiant and fire damage each increase by {@scaledamage 3d10|3-9|1d10} for every spell slot level above 3.

spell.name: Starfall
entries: A sphere of radiance falls from above and strikes the target. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 8d6} radiant damage on a failure and half as much on a success. All other creatures within 20 feet of it must also make a Constitution saving throw or become {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of your next turn.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: The damage increases by {@scaledamage 8d6|4-9|1d6} for each spell slot level above 4.

spell.name: Starlight's Shadow

components.m: a pinch of charcoal and chalk

entries: You cover a creature with a cloak of stars and shadows. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, the target can raise or lower the hood; you choose if it is raised or lowered when you cast the spell. With the hood lowered, the target has a flying speed of 60 feet and resistance to necrotic damage. With the hood raised, the target is {@condition Invisible|XPHB} and has resistance to radiant damage; if the target makes an attack or forces another creature to make a saving throw, the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition ends until the start of their next turn.

spell.name: Starlight Sending
entries: You place an illusory image of yourself within 10 feet of a willing creature of your choosing. If the creature is not willing, the spell fails. The image appears to be made of stars, with constellation lines joining them, and an ethereal blue mist filling the space inbetween. For the next minute, you can converse and see as if you were there. Your physical self is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} for the duration.

spell.name: Astral Convocation

m.text: four dice made of stained glass, each worth at least 150gp

entries: You call on a council of astral spirits, gaining their blessings and insights.
You regain your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} at the start of every turn.

When a creature within 30 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can use your Reaction to allow them to roll an additional d20, you choose which result to use. When you use this reaction, you can cause that creature to regain {@dice 5} hit points.

spell.name: Celestial Alignment

m.text: a set of ten engraved constellation tiles, worth 500gp

entries: You examine the stars, and attempt to pull their alignment into one that is favourable for you. Roll {@damage 10d10}. The number of dice you get that matches any other dice determines the effect, described below.

{@note For the purpose of this spell, the number of matching dice refers to any die that has the same value as another, and not all matches need to share their value. Rolling 1, 2, 2, 4, 5, 5, 5, 9, 10, 10 would be 7 matches.}

items.name: No Matches
entries: You die.

items.name: Two Matches: Luck Sacrifice
entries: Until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests}. The nearest creature to you (if multiple creatures are equally distant, you choose) has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} for the next hour.

items.name: Three Matches: Chaos
entries: Whenever a creature rolls a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB} within 60 feet of you, it rolls twice and uses the result furthest from 10.

items.name: Four Matches: Realignment
entries: You and every creature within 60 feet of you immediately gain the benefit of the {@spell Starlike Skim|Starlight} spell and can immediately use the movement granted by the spell.

items.name: Five Matches: Starfall
entries: A creature of your choice that you can see within 90 feet takes radiant damage equal to the total you rolled.

items.name: Six Matches: Protection
entries: A creature of your choice that you can see within 90 feet gains hit points equal to the total rolled, and a creature you can see within 90 feet gains temporary hit points equal to the total rolled.

items.name: Seven Matches: Starlight Blessings
entries: You and any creatures of your choice within 30 feet are blessed: you gain the benefits of the {@spell Bless|XPHB} spell until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items.name: Eight Matches: Personal Alignment
entries: For the next minute, whenever a creature within 30 feet of you makes a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can add or subtract one of the dice rolled from the total. Dice that are 6 or higher can be added, and dice that are 5 or lower can be subtracted. Once you have used one of the rolled dice, you cannot use it again.

items.name: Nine Matches: Restoration
entries: All creatures of your choice that you can see regain hit points equal to the total rolled and any conditions of their choice end on them.

items.name: Ten Matches: Will of Fate
entries: You immediately cast the {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell (no action required). You can duplicate a spell of up to 9th level without incurring the stress described in the spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot
entries: Roll an additional {@scaledamage 10d10|7-9|1d10} for each spell slot level above 7.

spell.name: Gravitic Flux

m.text: a dense metal sphere worth 1000gp and weighting at least 10lbs

entries: You create a 30-foot radius sphere of violently-shifting gravity centered on a point you can see within range. Teleportation through the edge of the field is impossible. When the spell is cast, and at the start of each of your turns, choose a flux state from the options below. The effect applies to all creatures within the area.

items.name: Collapse
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Strength saving throw or be pulled 10 feet towards the center and take {@damage 5d10} force damage. On a successful, they take half damage and are not pulled.

items.name: Inversion
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw or be pulled 30 feet into the air and {@condition Restrained|XPHB}. At the end of their next turn they are pulled into the ground as if they had fallen that distance and the condition ends.

items.name: Temporal Distortion
entries: Creatures in the area must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, they cannot take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|Reactions}, and become {@condition Dazed|Starlight}. The effect lasts until you create a different flux state.

items.name: Event Horizon
entries: The field becomes challenging to escape. A creature that attempts to leave the field by any means must make a Charisma saving throw or become {@condition Halted|Starlight} until the end of their turn, and the attempt fails. When a creature fails this saving throw, it takes {@damage 3d10} force damage.

items.name: Density
entries: The field becomes difficult terrain. When a creature moves within the area, it takes {@damage 2d10} force damage for every 5 feet it moves.

spell.name: Eclipse
entries: The air darkens around you. A 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centred on you is filled with Dim Light as you absorb the light from the sky. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet, and become resistant to fire, cold, radiant and necrotic damage.

All creatures of your choice within the emanation must subtract your spellcasting ability modifier from any damage rolls they make. Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action}, you can target a creature within the emanation to draw power from them. That creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take {@damage 4d10} radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) and become {@condition Silenced|Starlight} until the start of your next turn, taking half as much damage only on a successful one. You gain temporary hit points equal to the amount of damage dealt.

spell.name: Guidance
entries: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a {@dice d4} and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

condition.name: Dazed
entries: While you have the Dazed condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Movement Affected
entries: Your movement speed is {@condition Slowed|Starlight}.

entries.name: Actions Affected
entries: On your turn you can take either an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, but not both.
If you become dazed during your turn, this takes effect retroactively: if you have used only your Action or Bonus Action, you cannot take the other.

condition.name: Disoriented
entries: While you have the Disoriented condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Ability Checks Affected
entries: You have disadvantage on Wisdom and Intelligence {@variantrule Ability Check|XPHB|ability checks}.

entries.name: Attacks and Spells Affected
entries: If you attack using an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can only make one attack as part of that {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.
Additionally, you cannot cast spells higher than first level.

condition.name: Overwhelmed
entries: While you have the Overwhelmed condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Actions and Movement Prevented
entries: An overwhelmed creature is {@condition incapacitated} and {@condition halted|Starlight}.

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: Attacks against you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB|saving throws}.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: The condition can be ended on a creature if another creature spends an Action or Bonus Action to help them recover.

condition.name: Weakened
entries: While you have the Weakened condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: You deal half damage with effects that require an attack roll.

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: If an effect does not require an attack roll, targets instead have advantage on any saving throw or ability check made to resist it.

condition.name: Off-balance
entries: While you have the Off-balance condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: Attacks against you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and your attacks have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on any checks or saving throws you make to avoid being forcibly moved or falling {@condition Prone}.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: The condition ends when you take damage, or you miss an attack roll.

condition.name: Exposed
entries: While you have the Exposed condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: Successful attacks against an exposed creature count as a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.

condition.name: Marked
entries: While you have the Marked condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Attacks Affected
entries: Attack rolls against you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if the attacker can see you.

condition.name: Silenced
entries: While you have the Silenced condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Spells and Speech Affected
entries: A silenced creature cannot speak, or cast spells requiring verbal components.

condition.name: Sundered
entries: While you have the Sundered condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Defense Affected
entries: The creature's armour class cannot benefit from armour or shields, but still gains any special bonuses to AC that those items offer (such as a +1 shield). If the armour would limit the creature's Dexterity modifier bonus to armour class (such as Half-Plate or Plate armour) or impose disadvantage on Stealth (Dexterity) checks, it still does.

condition.name: Staggered
entries: While you have the Staggered condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Defense Affected
entries: Your Dexterity modifier cannot increase your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|Armour Class}.

condition.name: Bleeding
entries: While you have the Bleeding condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Damage Received
entries: You take 3 slashing damage at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: You can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to attempt a DC 10 {@skill Medicine} check to stop the bleeding.
Regaining any hit points also ends the condition.
If you are immune to slashing damage, you are immune to this condition. If you are resistant to slashing damage, you have advantage on any saving throws against the condition instead.

condition.name: Burning
entries: While you have the Burning condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Damage Received
entries: You take {@dice 1d4} fire damage at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Actions Affected
entries: You cannot use a free time-limited object interaction, you must use the {@action Utilize|XPHB|Utilise} action to interact with objects (such as drawing a weapon or opening doors).

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: You can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to attempt a DC 10 {@skill Medicine} check to stop the burning.
If you are immune to fire damage, you are immune to this condition. If you are resistant to fire damage, you have advantage on any saving throws against the condition instead.

condition.name: Shocked
entries: While you have the Shocked condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Reactions Affected
entries: Whenever you take a Reaction, you take {@dice 2d4} lightning damage.

entries.name: Saving Throws Affected
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: If you are immune to Lightning damage, you are immune to this condition. If you are resistant to lightning damage, you have advantage on any saving throws against the condition instead.

condition.name: Melting
entries: While you have the Melting condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Defense Affected
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB|Armour Class} is reduced by 2.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: You or a nearby creature can use an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to clear the acid or other substance causing the condition, if there is one.
If you are immune to acid damage, you are immune to this condition. If you are resistant to acid damage, you have advantage on any saving throws against the condition instead.

condition.name: Brittle
entries: While you have the Brittle condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: Your movement is {@condition Hampered}.

entries.name: Damage Increased
entries: When you take any damage, that damage is increased by {@dice 2}.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: The condition ends after you take fire damage.
If you are immune to cold damage, you are immune to this condition. If you are resistant to cold damage, you have advantage on any saving throws against the condition instead.

condition.name: Rattled
entries: While you have the Rattled condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Attacks
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage} on all ranged attacks.

entries.name: Movement Penalties
entries: You take {@dice 2d6} bludgeoning damage if you move 30 feet on your turn.

condition.name: Backlash
entries: While you have the Backlash condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Magic Backlash
entries: When you cast a spell, you take force damage depending on the spell's level. The damage is determined by rolling a number of d4s equal to the spell's level plus one.

condition.name: Seared
entries: While you have the Seared condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Easily Perceived
entries: You cannot be {@condition Invisible|XPHB} or benefit from {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half or Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Radiant Weakness
entries: When you take Radiant damage, that damage is increased by {@dice 1d10}.

condition.name: Frayed
entries: While you have the Frayed condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Saves Affected
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage} on Wisdom {@variantrule saving throws|XPHB|saving throws}.

entries.name: Concentration Affected
entries: You must make a DC 15 Constitution {@variantrule saving throws|XPHB|saving throw} at the end of each of your turns or lose your {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: You can spend an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your turn to end the condition.

condition.name: Withering
entries: While you have the Withering condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Healing Affected
entries: You cannot gain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hit Die Cost
entries: At the start of each of your turns, lose one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}. If you have none, you gain a level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ending the Condition
entries: You can spend an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} on your turn to end the condition.

condition.name: Hampered
entries: While you have the Hampered condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet.

entries.name: Multiple Penalties
entries: You can be Hampered more than once, increasing the speed penalty, but not from the same source.

condition.name: Slowed
entries: While you have the Slowed condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved.

condition.name: Sluggish
entries: While you have the Sluggish condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced to 10 feet.

condition.name: Halted
entries: While you have the Halted condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Restricted Movement
entries: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 and cannot increase.

items: If you start your turn while Dying, you roll a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB}. Regaining any hit points ends this condition on you. Being stabilised via a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check prevents only the death saving throw rolls.
You are prone and cannot get up.
On your turn, you can move, or take an action or a bonus action. Taking an action gives two levels of exhaustion, bonus actions and reactions give one.

condition.name: Spell Power
entries: While you have the Spell Power condition, you experience the following effects.

entries.name: Spells Affected
entries: You deal increased damage with your spells. Whenever you roll damage for a spell, add your Spell Power to the damage roll.
{@note The increase depends on the source of the condition. This could be denoted as "Spell Power (X)". You can gain this condition multiple times, adding the total together.}

feat.name: Mark of the Prophet
entries: You carry a vestige of the world: a sign that you will work to usher the world along its path and into the future.

entries.name: Understanding
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Guiding Hand
entries: You know the {@spell Guidance|XPHB} cantrip. When you cast it on another creature, you can increase the bonus by {@dice 1d4}. This bonus increases at levels 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}) and 18 ({@dice 4d4}).
You can increase the bonus this way once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a Short Rest.

feat.name: Mark of the Warden
entries: You carry a vestige of the world: a sign that you will protect the world and preserve the current way of life.

entries.name: Preservation
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana} or {@skill Nature}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Protection
entries: You always have the {@spell Divine Shield|Starlight} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have.

When you cast the spell, you can instead cast it as a {@variantrule Reaction} to another creature being hit by an attack. You can cast the spell this way once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a Long Rest.

feat.name: Mark of the Harbinger
entries: You carry a vestige of the world: a sign that you will seek a sudden and drastic change to the world of your own design.

entries.name: Warning
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation} or {@skill Deception}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

feat.name: Mark of the Prophet
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Understanding
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Guiding Hand
entries: You always have the {@spell Guidance|ST} cantrip prepared.

When you cast it on another creature, you can increase the bonus by {@dice 1d4}. This increases to {@dice 2d4} at 5th level, {@dice 3d4} at 11th level, and {@dice 4d4} at 17th level. You can use this enhancement once, and regain the ability to use it when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of the Prophet Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

entries.caption: Mark of the Prophet Spells
rows: {@spell Aura of Purity|XPHB}, {@spell Freedom of Movement|XPHB}

feat.name: Mark of the Warden
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Preservation
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) or Intelligence ({@skill Nature|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Protection
entries: You always have the {@spell Divine Shield|ST} spell prepared. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

When you cast this spell, you can instead cast it as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to another creature being hit by an attack. You can do so once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of the Warden Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

feat.name: Mark of the Harbinger
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Warning
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|XPHB}) or Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Herald of Change
entries: When you reach character level 3, you always have the {@spell Vortex Warp|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

When you cast this spell, you can target two creatures instead of one, and the additional target can be yourself. You can do so once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of the Harbinger Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

feat.name: Mark of Glass
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Fracture
entries: When you make a Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB}) or Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Rewrite
entries: You always have the {@spell Stellar Omen|ST} and {@spell Silvery Barbs|SCC} spells prepared.

When a creature within 30 feet of you targets you or another creature within 30 feet of you with an attack or spell, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to force them to target another creature in range instead. You cannot redirect a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. Once you use this feature, you must finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} to use it again.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Glass Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

feat.name: Mark of Elune
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Unity
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) or Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Holy Words
entries: You always have the {@spell Healing Word|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

When you cast this spell, you can either target an additional creature, or cause one creature within 60 feet to become {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you until the end of your next turn. You can do so once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of Elune Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

entries.caption: Mark of Elune Spells
rows: {@spell Fount of Moonlight|XPHB}, {@spell Aura of Life|XPHB}

feat.name: Mark of the Rifts
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Instability
entries: When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|XPHB}) or Intelligence ({@skill History|XPHB}) check, you can roll {@dice 1d4} and add the number rolled to the ability check.

entries.name: Surge
entries: You always have the {@spell Arcane Butterflies|ST} spell prepared. You can cast it once without expending a spell slot, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

When you cast a spell using a spell slot of 1st level or higher, you can gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the spell attack roll or increase its save DC by 1, and then trigger a {@table Wild Magic Surge|XPHB}. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Spells of the Mark
entries: If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, the spells on the Mark of the Rifts Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

entries.name: Origin
entries: Faeries aren't common in most lands, though they're plentiful enough in the Faewilds. They have a propensity for discovery and adventure, looking for the joy and entertainment in things big and small.

entries.name: Creature Type
entries: You are a Fey.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and cannot be put to sleep by magical means.

entries.name: Flight
entries: Because of your wings, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can't use this flying speed if you're wearing medium or heavy armor.

entries.name: Quick and Nimble
entries: Your speed and size make you difficult to hit. You gain a +1 bonus to your AC while you are airborne.

entries.name: Tiny
entries: Your size is Tiny, making you easy to move. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength saving throws and Strength-based ability checks.

entries.name: Fairy Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Pixie Sparks|Starlight} cantrip.

Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell faerie fire} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell faerie fire} with this trait, you can't cast it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common, Sylvan, and one other language that you and your DM agree is appropriate for your character.

entries.name: Origin
entries: The Lacertal are a simple folk. Living peaceful lives in another plane. When the rifts appeared, this changed dramatically, and while they steer clear sometimes fate determine that one makes their way in, willfully or not.

Few survive the journey: going up is much harder than going down. Those that do rarely remember anything, especially if they are young, and none so far have made it to civilisation meaningfully. The lacertal learned to steer clear long ago, and even with only primitive communication warnings of the rift are passed through generations.

Of course, this doesn't stop any particularly foolhardy, sneaky, and curious lacertal from entering anyway. However they end up in the rift, it is likely to change them in ways that make them hard to recognise back home.

entries.name: Winged Form
entries: You have a flying speed equal to your movement speed.

entries.name: Malformed Wings
entries: You fall at the end of your turn if you are airborne and the only thing holding you aloft is your flying speed.

entries.name: Rift Magic Exposure
entries: Your exposure to the wild magics of Delamir has given you some innate spellcasting, connected to the elements. You know one cantrip from the {@filter druid spell list|spells|level=0|class=Druid}. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that spell with a different one from the Druid Spell list.
Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for any spell you cast with this trait (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have Proficiency in the {@skill Perception} Skill.

entries.name: Tempestborn Resistance
entries: You have resistance to lightning damage and thunder damage.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Healing Hands
entries: As an action, you can touch a creature and roll a number of d4s equal to your proficiency bonus. The creature regains a number of hit points equal to the total rolled. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Light Bearer
entries: You know the {@spell light} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Fulgur's Fury
entries: When you reach 3rd level, you can use a bonus action to unleash the divine lightning within yourself, causing arcs of lightning to emenate from you. Your transformation lasts for 1 minute or until you end it as a bonus action.

During your transformation, you shed bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet, and at the end of each of your turns, each creature within 10 feet of you takes lightning damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Until the transformation ends, once on each of your turns, you can deal extra lightning damage to one target when you deal damage to it with an attack or a spell. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.
Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Origin
entries: Profane Elves originate from a dark ritual, giving a soul from the abyss a physical form. This grants them the ability to remain in the realm without issue. Without it, the soul cannot maintain its presence in the True Material.

While they take the physical shape and build of an elf, their lifespan is essentially random, and there is no process of maturing or aging otherwise. Typically, a profane elf would die in combat, their body would turn to ashes and their soul return to the lower planes.

Unlike other Sun'Dorai methods of taking form in the True Material plane, profane elves do not possess an alternate form. Once this body has reached its limit, it breaks. Healing is a slow process with this body, as parts may turn to ash when they are removed.

entries.name: Age
entries: You are created mature, and could in theory live indefinitely, provided your body does not take damage too severe. No upper age limit is known for a Profane Elf, but no magic lasts forever.

entries.name: Size
entries: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds, which you have inherited as a part of your creation. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Their abyssal heritage grants Profane Elves superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Abyssal Heritage
entries: The ritual that brought you to this plane confers some of your heritage's resilience and knowledge. You have resistance to fire and poison damage. Additionally, you can speak, read, and write Abyssal.

entries.name: Abyssal Magics
entries: You know the {@spell thaumaturgy} cantrip. Once you reach 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell hellish rebuke} spell as a 2nd-level spell with this trait; you regain the ability to cast it when you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have Proficiency in the {@skill Perception} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: Elves don't need to sleep, and the ritual that created you has granted you the same ability. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day. (The Common word for such meditation is "trance.") While meditating, you have visions of the Abyss, instead of dreams. After resting in this way, you gain the same benefit that a human does from 8 hours of sleep.
{@note If you meditate during a long rest, you finish the rest after only 4 hours. You otherwise obey all the rules for a long rest; only the duration is changed.}

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4-7 feet tall) or Small (about 3-4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Abyssal Legacy
entries: You are the recipient, by whatever means, of the legacy of the Queen of the Abyss, Lycera. This grants you supernatural abilities as detailed below.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you gain this legacy).

entries.caption: Fiendish Legacies
rows: You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Necrotic damage. You also know the {@spell Primordial Spark|Starlight} cantrip.

entries.name: Otherworldly Presence
entries: You know the {@spell Thaumaturgy|XPHB} cantrip. When you cast it with this trait, the spell uses the same spellcasting ability you use for your Abyssal Legacy Trait.

entries.name: Origin
entries: It is rare to a see someone with a legacy such as this. Lycera does not often make her presence known in this way, and even being born in her very domain would not be sufficient. A period of sufficient exposure could leave one corrupted in such a way that the body takes on the traits listed here.

One such example would be Adorea, once-Anathema. Even Imprisoned, so many years spent in the home base of Lycera's corruption had a, maybe irreversible, effect on her physiology. Her mother is the same way, though she kept it a secret for a longer time.
